**Job ID** 19469 **Location** Los Angeles, California, United States **Job Category** Administrative **Date posted** 09/23/2026

**Job Description**
-------------------


Align yourself with an organization that has a reputation for excellence. Cedars\-Sinai was awarded the National Research Corporation’s Consumer Choice Award 19 years in a row for providing the highest\-quality medical care in Los Angeles. We were also awarded the Advisory Board Company’s Workplace of the Year. We offer an outstanding benefits package including health care, generous time off and a 403(B). Join us! Discover why U.S. News \& World Report has named us one of America’s Best Hospitals.


**What will I be doing in this role?**
  

The Program/Project Coordinator provides strategic support to a mid to large scale, recognized organizational program, leading Cedars\-Sinai system wide strategy for social drivers of health screening, partnerships, and intervention programs. You will coordinate all operations for the assigned program or project to facilitate the effective management of programs/projects according to organizational standards:


Coordinates and maintains applicable program/project schedules and agendas. This may include tracking deadlines, deliverables, composing meeting minutes and other correspondence/communication with management and/or partners.


Interfaces with other departments, staff, leaders and/or other partners in the administration of the program/project. Provide coordination of applicable logistics or information as directed by leadership.


Organizes and coordinates the development of all featured events, outreach activities, meetings and materials/collateral; in the promotion and administration of the program/project. May actively represent the program and/or the organization.


Helps foster a collaborative and positive relationship building dynamic with internal staff and external parties. May be responsible for providing any applicable education, training, on\-boarding and/or mentorship pertaining to program/project.


Supports the development and management of program/project budgets; maintain and track all supporting budget/financial files and documents. Collaborates with other departments, vendors and applicable community parties as needed.


Responsible for creating reports for management in the evaluation of the program/project performance or day\-to\-day operations. May also be responsible for documenting and tracking program/project compliance.
  

May provide feedback to management and make recommendations regarding program/project operations and/or procedures.  

  



**Qualifications**
------------------


**Requirements:**
  

* High school diploma/GED required. Bachelor's degree in health care, business administration, management or another relevant major preferred.
* A minimum of 2 years of progressively responsible administrative or strategic support experience required.
* A minimum of 3 years of organizational program or project coordination/support experience, using program/project management and development procedures preferred.
* Experience with or passion for health equity, social drivers of health, community health worker programs or community partnerships a plus.
  

  

**Why work here?**
  

Beyond outstanding employee benefits including health and dental insurance, paid vacation, and a 403(b), we take pride in hiring the best, most passionate employees. Our accomplished staff reflects the culturally and ethnically diverse community we serve. They are proof of our commitment to creating a dynamic, inclusive environment that fuels innovation.

jobs.description:
Under the guidance and direction of the Director of IPE, the Program Coordinator supports the coordination and implementation of Interprofessional Education (IPE) learning experiences, activities, and related programming.  

  

  

This role collaborates closely with all members of the IPE support team to assist in the development, scheduling, implementation, and monitoring of IPE learning experiences and activities. The Program Coordinator helps ensure smooth delivery of IPE sessions by managing logistics, maintaining communication with stakeholders, and supporting day\-to\-day program operations across campus locations.
  

  

Based in Pomona, California, this position is primarily in\-person during the IPE academic semesters, with work focused on supporting students, faculty, and staff in IPE\-related activities. Outside of the academic semesters, the role continues with responsibilities related to IPE and broader university duties, including preparation for the upcoming academic year.

* Capable of performing on\-campus duties, including walking between locations and supporting in\-person activities.
* Ability to receive constructive feedback in a positive and professional manner, and to apply it for continuous learning and professional growth.

* High School Diploma or equivalent

jobs.title: Client Success Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Tax Titans**


Tax Titans helps individuals and businesses navigate tax challenges with clarity and confidence. Our team reviews each client’s unique situation, explains the available options, and develops a personalized strategy to help resolve outstanding tax matters. From tax investigation and compliance to resolution services, we’re committed to providing honest guidance, responsive support, and a straightforward path forward.

 **Client Success Coordinator**  

Tax Titans \| Sherman Oaks, CA \| Full\-time, in\-office

 **About the role**  

Tax Titans helps individuals and businesses resolve IRS and state tax problems. The Client Success Coordinator keeps active cases moving from signed client to resolution. You'll be the main point of contact for existing clients. That means collecting what we need, keeping files complete and current, and making sure every client is set up for the right outcome. You'll work closely with sales, tax professionals, and leadership.

 **Key responsibilities**

*Client outreach and case preparation*

* Reach out to existing clients to collect documents and information needed to move their cases forward
* Schedule and complete financial statements (e.g., Form 433\-A) to prepare cases for resolution and identify additional service opportunities
* Make sure all required documents are in place, including authorizations, agreements, and supporting forms
* Provide regular status updates to active clients

*Client support*

* Manage inbound client calls, texts, and emails, and resolve or route inquiries promptly
* Serve as first point of contact on cancellation and refund requests, escalating to leadership before anything is processed
* Support the sales and resolution teams as needed to move clients through each stage

*Payments*

* Follow up on declined or defaulted payments and work with clients to get accounts current
* Monitor payment plans and flag at\-risk accounts

*Case management*

* Monitor the virtual mailbox, upload new tax notices and correspondence to client files, and alert assigned team members
* Track deadlines for notice responses, document requests, and agreement payments
* Keep client records, notes, and statuses up to date in the CRM
* Review new cases at handoff from sales to confirm scope, fees, and file setup are accurate
* Take on other operational and client\-facing tasks as the team grows

**What we're looking for**

* 2\+ years in customer service, client success, or case management (tax, financial, or legal experience a plus)
* Strong phone and written communication skills; calm and clear with frustrated clients
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage many open files and deadlines at once
* Comfortable collecting sensitive financial information professionally and confidentially
* Experience with a CRM and phone/texting platforms preferred
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable owning a process end to end
  

**The pay range for this role is:**  

25 \- 25 USD per hour(Sherman Oaks, CA)

**About Sierra Roof**

Sierra is an established Southern California roofing and exterior remodeling company serving homeowners throughout the region. We are looking for a highly organized, dependable, and energetic **Bilingual Field Production Coordinator / Project Supervisor** to help manage residential roofing, window, paint, and exterior improvement projects.

This is not strictly an office position. The person hired will work from our Anaheim office and visit active job sites to coordinate crews, meet inspectors, communicate with homeowners, document progress, resolve production issues, collect payments, and help bring every project to a successful close.

The ideal candidate takes ownership, communicates professionally, handles multiple active projects without losing details, and understands the importance of keeping customers informed throughout construction.

**Operations Coordinator**

**Summary**

The Operations Coordinator supports day‑to‑day logistics and order fulfillment activities while serving as a key point of contact for customers. This role is responsible for processing B2B and B2C orders, coordinating with warehouses and 3PL partners, maintaining accurate data in ERP/WMS systems, and assisting with inventory, documentation, and billing support. The ideal candidate is detail‑oriented, customer‑focused, and eager to learn logistics operations in a fast‑paced environment. Strong communication skills, teamwork, and basic proficiency in Microsoft Office are preferred, and with Korean language skills considered a requirement.

· Coordinating operational tasks between the customer to warehouse teams.

· Documenting order data, inventory, and accounting details into systems.

· Sole key partner between customers, operations, and vendors in getting the job done.

**Typical Day**

A typical day for the Operations Coordinator begins at 8:00 a.m., reviewing incoming orders, checking inventory levels, and coordinating with the warehouse team to ensure orders are picked, packed, and shipped accurately. Throughout the day, they update order information in the ERP/WMS system, monitor shipments, and respond to customer and client inquiries via email or phone. They work closely with internal teams to resolve any order, inventory, or carrier issues, assist with shipping documentation, and support basic billing activities as needed. The day also includes tracking data, flagging discrepancies, and contributing to small process improvements before wrapping up tasks and handoffs by 5:00 p.m.

Your energetic approach will help us build vibrant communities, enhance brand visibility, and deliver measurable marketing results. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to develop your skills in digital marketing, content creation, and media analytics while working with a dynamic team committed to excellence.

* Develop, implement, and manage engaging social media content across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok to increase brand awareness and audience engagement.
* Monitor social media channels using tools like Hootsuite or Buffer to track performance metrics, analyze trends, and optimize content strategies based on data insights.

jobs.title: Associate Account Manager
jobs.description:
Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting\-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.


**Why Join Us?**

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.


We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time\-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.


**Associate Account Manager \- West Hollywood**

  

**Introduction to the team:**

The Associate Account Manager’s primary responsibility is to develop and maintain a high\-quality portfolio of relevant, attractive, and competitive hotel and property products for Expedia Group’s fast\-growing global traveler base. The Associate Market Manager works with lodging partners within their assigned territory to help maximize the production potential in the marketplace.  



  

**Make an impact!**

The Account Management team ensures that global travelers always find the most suitable property for their dream trip and that hotel partners can reach Expedia Group’s full breadth of global traveler demand  



  

**In this role, you will:**

* Proactively and consistently demonstrate the unique value proposition of partnering with Expedia Group

Drive for results

jobs.title: GCP Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III), you will support Public Sector customers with cloud adoption, operational planning, technical issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination. Working alongside senior team members, you will help maintain account health and coordinate activities across customer and delivery partner teams. You will contribute to reliable, secure cloud outcomes in complex public\-sector environments. This remote role is available to candidates who can work from within the continental United States.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/21/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III) on the AI \& Engineering team, you will be responsible for:
  

* Coordinate technical activities across assigned customer workstreams and track customer issues, risks, dependencies, action items, and upcoming milestones.
* Collaborate with client Support, Product Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and customer escalations.
* Support customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, and operational readiness activities.
* Prepare materials for technical reviews, quarterly business reviews, and customer meetings; document customer needs and communicate product feedback to client teams.
* Recommend Google Cloud practices that improve adoption, reliability, security, and performance; escalate complex technical or customer issues to the Senior Technical Account Manager.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

At Deloitte, AI \& Engineering brings together engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated, sector\-focused solutions across software, data, artificial intelligence, networks, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. Our teams help clients modernize technology and data platforms, improve mission\-critical operations, and create business value through scalable engineering solutions. We tailor our delivery approach to each client's priorities, operating environment, and transformation goals.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree or 12\+ years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, software development, or technical consulting.
* 4\+ years of experience supporting customers with Google Cloud implementations, cloud transformation programs, technical support, customer launches, release management, escalations, or technical consulting.
* 1\+ years of experience designing, developing, supporting, or operating microservices, distributed systems, and application programming interfaces (APIs) using software development practices.
* Must currently hold a Google Cloud Professional certification in at least one of the following: Professional Cloud Architect; Professional Cloud Database Engineer; Professional Cloud Developer; Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer; Professional Cloud Network Engineer; Professional Cloud Security Engineer; Professional Data Engineer; Professional Machine Learning Engineer; or Professional Security Operations Engineer.
* Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  

**Preferred:**  

* Experience supporting public\-sector customers in Google Cloud environments.
* Experience coordinating customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, or operational readiness activities.
* Experience preparing materials for technical reviews or quarterly business reviews.

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,000 to $170,000\.  

  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Amazon Ads operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of advertising solutions. * Become a knowledgeable partner on Amazon Advertising solutions with revenue experience
* Develop annual brand and media strategies for growth based on overall advertiser goals/objectives

* Evaluate KPIs and optimize campaign performance using a data driven approach

* 2\+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience

* Experience with problem solving and disruptive innovation, developing technology programs and working across customer organizations
* Experience in process improvement

----------------------------

* 4\+ years of marketing, brand advertising, media sales or online advertising work and close work with senior advertisers and agency stakeholders experience

* Can communicate effectively with all levels of the organization
* Experience in programmatic strategy and implementation
* Experience communicating effectively with external partners and delivering results for advertisers

*Common Sense is restoring trust in local government. We build AI for public servants and the communities they serve. Our team comes from technology leaders like Palantir, Apple, SpaceX, and Amazon, with a fundamental belief that the top technologists and operators should serve the public good, rather than optimizing social media feeds.*

You'll also help plan and staff industry conferences. You'll work directly with the Head of Growth and founding team to accelerate our outbound sales motion.

* Treat sales development as a craft, not as a stepping stone.

* Run outbound email and LinkedIn campaigns with personalized, well\-researched messaging.

* Help plan, coordinate, and attend industry conferences to build relationships and generate pipeline.

**Requirements** **What We're Looking For:**

* 1\-3 years of professional experience. Sales, business development, consulting, political campaigns, or any client\-facing work all count.
* Strong writing skills. Your outreach needs to sound like a person, not a template.
* Comfortable building process where none exists yet.
* Results\-oriented. You keep score.
* A background in political science, public policy, government, or something adjacent is a plus but not required.
* Experience selling to state, local, police, fire, or education (SLED) customers is a bonus.
* Based in Los Angeles or willing to relocate.

  

**Benefits** **Why Now? Why Common Sense?**


This is a ground floor opportunity at a well\-capitalized venture\-backed company that's growing fast. jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Saddleback Communications Team serves as the Creative \& Marketing talent for Saddleback Church. What we do touches every aspect of our church and is, most times, the first exposure individuals get to Saddleback Church.



We use graphics, photography, social media, email marketing, personalized messaging, and storytelling to showcase who we are as a church community and, through it, impact the community and world around us.



This position is the connective tissue of our team. He/she owns the church\-wide communication calendar — the single place where every promotion, series, and event lives — and makes sure the weekend actually happens: host scripts written, assets delivered to Production and Experience on time, signage thought through, Church News supported. Are you the person who sees the whole board, keeps a dozen moving pieces on schedule, and writes well while doing it?



Saddleback Church is looking for a Marketing Coordinator who loves bringing order to creative work so that what our church says on any given weekend is clear, on time, and on mission.


**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**


**WEEKEND COMMUNICATIONS COORDINATION**


* Write weekend host scripts and announcement copy, tailored to the host and aligned with established on\-camera conventions and the Saddleback voice.
* Coordinate and deliver weekend and event assets to the Production and Experience teams on schedule — signs, screens, motion, lower thirds, script versions, and run\-of\-show communication needs.
* Support Church News: gather and prioritize announcement content, prepare and route drafts, and coordinate revisions with the host, video producer, and Marketing Director.
* Serve as the weekend point of contact for communications questions and be present at weekends and key events as required.


**COMMUNICATION CALENDAR MANAGEMENT**


* Own and maintain the church\-wide communication and promotions calendar — the authoritative view of what is being promoted, on which channels, and when.
* Manage the process for promotional campaign builds; apply agreed\-upon prioritization criteria and flag conflicts, over\-promotion, and gaps before they reach the congregation.
* Assist with sequencing promotions against the master calendar, message series, and major church\-wide initiatives so campaigns launch with adequate lead time.
* Communicate calendar decisions and deadlines clearly to Communications, ministry, and weekend teams, maintaining a high level of customer service across teams.
* Keep the calendar and supporting systems current, and assist with maintaining marketing dashboards and assessment tools.


**WEEKLY DELIVERABLES AND PROJECT COORDINATION**


* Manage communication projects and campaigns from inception to completion as assigned.
* Support the development and deployment of communication plans within desired timelines that accomplish marketing goals and align with the mission and vision of Saddleback Church.


**COPYWRITING, EDITING, AND PROOFREADING**


* Write and edit copy provided by the Communications team, other teams, and pastoral staff.
* Proofread copy to identify and fix errors in grammar, spelling, and punctuation before anything reaches the congregation.
* Uphold and steward the Saddleback voice as defined by the Editorial Style Guide.
* Assist with content curation, research on projects, and corroboration of facts and substance of content.


**DECISION MAKING**


* Empowered to make decisions within the function of the Marketing Team — including calendar sequencing, weekend asset deadlines, and script and copy edits — escalating strategy and priority conflicts to the Marketing Director.


**OTHER**


* Perform a variety of duties including but not limited to: special projects, assisting other teams, research, and filling in where requested.


**WHO YOU ARE:**


* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to communicate complex ideas and projects in a clear and effective way.
* Impeccable grammar and a strong proofreading eye.
* Script and announcement writing for live and on\-camera delivery, or a demonstrated ability to learn it quickly.
* Exceptional organization; able to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously without dropping details.
* Calm and clear under weekend timelines; comfortable making the call when an asset is late.
* Organized, creative, and confident, valuing research and accuracy.
* Highly relational; able to work as a team player and discuss needs, challenges, and ideas across teams.
* Thrives in supporting and enabling a collaborative culture aimed toward building better results.
* Proficient knowledge of Google Suite; working knowledge of Adobe CS preferred.
* Sound understanding of marketing principles, effective project management, and excellent organizational skills.


**WHAT YOU HAVE DONE:**


* 1\-3\+ years of working experience required.
* 2\+ years of experience writing or editing marketing copy for digital and print platforms.
* Experience coordinating projects, calendars, or production schedules across multiple stakeholders.
* An ideal candidate has prior experience in church or para\-church communications, or experience in external or in\-house agencies in a similar function.


**EDUCATION**


* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, English, Communications, or a related field preferred.


**WHAT WE OFFER**


* Highly competitive benefits plans. Health plans with employee low deductible medical (EPO and PPO), dental, and vision coverage.

jobs.description:

***Why Lucky Strike?***

We Are Lucky Strike Entertainment, one of the largest and most successful location\-based entertainment companies in the World with 360 upscale and traditional Bowling Centers, five expansive and well\-located Waterparks, a large Amusement Park in California and 10 upscale Boomers Family Entertainment Centers in major markets.

From a humble beginning with one bowling center in 1997, we redefined an industry and built a powerhouse Company with 14,000 Associates and nearly $1\.4 billion in annual revenue. Hospitality is our core and we strive to deliver memorable experiences for every guest on every visit.

When you join Lucky Strike, you join a team of passionate winners and give yourself the best opportunity for sustained career growth and opportunity. It’s not easy to get hired by us – we want only the most talented and committed Managers, but when you do join Lucky Strike, the rewards are abundant.  


Overview:

Imagine your ideal job. Now add bowling, arcade games, amazing parties, and delicious food. This isn’t any ordinary office; it’s the beginning of a bowled new career as an **Event Operations Manager.**

  

Our Event Operations Managers know what it means to throw the perfect party. They manage a staff of Event Hosts who work diligently to ensure our event clients and guests are totally satisfied with every aspect of their events. Reporting to the center’s General Manager, the Event Operations Manager is a great opportunity for someone with exceptional organizational skills and amazing people skills to match.

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES:** ***Get a glimpse of all you’ll experience as an Event Operations Manager***

* Host special events; manage your team of event hosts; oversee all setup of appropriate areas

**ALWAYS BE IMPROVING**

* Ensure the completion of all event reporting and use guest feedback reports to continuously improve guest satisfaction

**MANAGE THE TEAM**

* Utilize our client database to forecast events and schedule our event staff appropriately; counsel and discipline staff as required according to HR guidelines and policies

**REMAIN FLEXIBLE**

* Be available to work varying shifts, from weekends to holidays, in addition to extended workdays as needed by your center

You’re an event professional who knows that the secret to every great party is a room full of satisfied guests. You have experience leading a team and knowledge of the hospitality industry and event planning/execution. You’re also a rock\-solid communicator whose interpersonal skills are second to none. And since events aren’t always 9 to 5, you’re flexible to work a variety of shifts, from weekends and holidays to extended workdays. **DESIRED SKILLS:** ***Check out the desired skills below and see if you have what it takes to join our world\-class team***

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Location: Irvine, CA

Schedule: Full\-Time \| 40 hours/week M\-F \| In\-Person

Pay Type: Salary \+ Benefits \| Starting Annual Salary at $71,000

At 454 Creative, we are all about growth! We see it as our mission to come alongside SMBs, credit unions, universities, and non\-profits with digital marketing and sales expertise to help them grow. The Account Manager acts as a liaison between 454 Creative and our clients, setting digital strategies that align with our client’s goals, nurturing clients through the agency processes and ensuring they are satisfied with our services and creative outcomes. This job is a good fit for someone who is both strategic and relational, loves building bridges with others as a part of a team, and is an effective communicator.

Here is a quick snapshot of some of the responsibilities of the Account Manager

**ACCOUNT BRAND STRATEGY**

* Translate the scope of work/proposal and the needs of the clients into a cohesive, actionable, strategic plan with specific tactics, often known as a 3 Month Tactical Plans (3MTPs).
* Complete Lean Marketing Framework sprints by working with the team to develop Brand Messaging, Digital Marketing Analysis (DMA), Customer Journey Funnel and 3MTP.
* Work with the Client to outline key objectives, desired outcomes and KPIs for the relationship.
* Host and lead all meetings with the client, pulling in appropriate 454 Creative Team Members and creating a prepared agenda to be sent out in advance to all participants.
* Review monthly reports from Digital Marketing Team before sending to client and work with the team to make recommendations as needed.
* Develop required content for emails, digital ads, lead magnets and other written pieces as needed.
* Maintain awareness of pay\-per\-click campaign strategies, objectives, budgets, account balances and communicate results, budget concerns and optimizations as needed.

**ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT**

* Act as an account manager to your assigned clients.
* Onboard new clients upon assignment:
* Send Welcome Packet and Introductory Emails
* Send appropriate Project Planners
* Request needed information and assets from clients
* Schedule initial meetings with clients and internal knowledge transfer meeting.
* Schedule all necessary meetings with Clients throughout their relationship with 454 Creative.
* Ensure actionable items from meetings, emails or conversations that are consistent with the Scope of Work and strategic plans, and if so, entered in Asana.
* Maintain close contact with clients, creating weekly touchpoints for project status updates or check\-ins, and provide opportunities for feedback, questions and concerns.
* Troubleshoot issues with clients as they arise.
* Work with Creative Team to ensure that all creative work\-product is meeting client needs, Scope of Work, and standard of excellence.
* Work with Project Manager to ensure tasks and timelines are understood and reasonable and communicate those timelines back to the client.
* Record Account Statuses weekly in Asana and report on client health at Account Status Meeting.
* Work with Project Manager to ensure clients are paying invoices promptly. Communicate work stoppage to Project Manager if necessary.
* Assess client health and report on quality of the engagement and relationship.
* Point out opportunities for 454 Creative to additionally engage with client, working with Director of Business Development to draft additional proposals and Scopes of Work.
* Look for areas where client isn’t maximizing their engagement with 454 Creative and champion the needs of the client, and the best practices/values of 454 Creative to the client.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

The Account Manager is a perfect role for a someone who can communicate excellently, thinks strategically and creatively, enjoys solving complex problems, and is good at developing rapport with others. The ideal candidate would have a bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Public Relations, Business Administration or a related field, and a baseline understanding of digital marketing principles, tools, and technologies. They would also have 2\-4 years of relevant client or account management experience.

**Preferred experience in these platforms:** 

* HubSpot

* Agency Analytics
* Google Analytics/Google Search Console/Google Tag Manager/Looker Studio
* SEMrush
* Sprout Social
* Asana
* Notion

* Keep Your Promises

jobs.title: Business Sales Representative - Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
**Exciting opportunity to be eligible for an $8,000 bonus when you join our team.**

  

As a **Lead Business Sales Representative \- Strategic Accounts,** you will own and grow a portfolio of complex, high\-growth Medium Business customers while developing new opportunities across assigned accounts. These customers are expanding, evolving, and navigating increasingly complex technology decisions, requiring a consultative seller who can build trust, uncover business needs, and position solutions that create measurable value. This is a strategic, quota\-carrying outside sales role for an experienced B2B seller who can balance account maintenance, service coordination, prospecting, pipeline creation, and complex solution selling. You will work closely with sales engineers, wired and mobility partners, indirect partners, and cross\-functional teams to help customers evaluate technology choices, solve business challenges, and invest in solutions that support long\-term growth. This role is designed for sellers who are technical, resourceful, disciplined, and comfortable competing in a sophisticated market where customers have more choices than ever.

 **Earn with confidence and upside.** This role offers a competitive base salary as well as performance\-based commission tied directly to your sales results. At 100% of target, **annual earnings range from $180,300 to $230,500\.** If you are motivated by ownership, measurable goals, and the ability to increase your income through performance, this role is designed for you.

 **What you’ll do**

* **Balance field and office collaboration:** When not in the field, sales employees are expected to collaborate with their team from their assigned office location and place of work.
* **Own and grow Platinum level accounts.** Build account plans that prioritize retention, expansion, new opportunity creation, customer relationship depth, and long\-term revenue growth.
* **Balance service and sales priorities.** Manage account maintenance and customer service needs while protecting time for prospecting, pipeline development, and closing new business.
* **Create and manage strategic pipelines.** Generate opportunities through account mapping, executive outreach, referrals, partner collaboration, customer expansion plays, and targeted prospecting.
* **Navigate complex technical solutions.** Learn and position wired, mobility, connectivity, and advanced technology solutions while translating technical capabilities into business outcomes.
* **Orchestrate internal and partner resources.** Collaborate with sales engineers, wired and mobility partners, indirect partners, product specialists, and support teams to design and deliver the right customer solution.
* **Differentiate in a competitive market.** Compete against direct providers, indirect competitors, vendors, resellers, and internal channel overlap by selling value, relationship, expertise, and business impact.
* **Lead a consultative sales process.** Diagnosing customer needs, uncover growth opportunities, overcome objections, and build solutions aligned to operational, technology, and financial priorities.
* **Maintain disciplined CRM and forecast accuracy.** Track pipeline, account activity, deal stage, next steps, expected close timing, and revenue impact with consistency and accuracy.
* **Protect customer relationships.** Serve as a trusted business advisor who can coordinate across service, sales, technical, and partner resources to help customers succeed.

 **What you’ll Bring**

  

* 8\+ years of successful outside B2B sales experience, preferably with complex accounts, telecommunications, technology, SaaS, mobility, wired solutions, or business services.
* Documented success meeting or exceeding quota in a full\-cycle sales role that required prospecting, account growth, negotiation, and closing.
* Ability to manage both sales and account\-maintenance demands without losing focus on pipeline creation and revenue growth.
* Strong technical curiosity and ability to learn complex product sets, internal processes, wired and mobility terminology, and solution\-design concepts.
* Demonstrated ability to work through internal teams, sales engineers, partner channels, and cross\-functional resources to solve customer problems.
* Strong territory, account planning, pipeline management, prioritization, and forecasting discipline.
* Comfortable competing in a market where customers evaluate multiple providers, vendors, resellers, and channel options.
* Valid driver’s license, satisfactory driving record, current auto insurance, and reliable transportation for market coverage.
* Bachelor’s degree is preferred, or equivalent combination of relevant sales experience and demonstrated performance.

  

Join a sales organization where complex account ownership, technical growth, and customer impact matter. In Platinum, you will manage meaningful business relationships, compete in a sophisticated market, and partner across sales engineering, mobility, wired, indirect, and support teams to solve customer problems. This role is designed for experienced sellers who want more than transactional selling: it offers the challenge of balancing account strategy, service demands, technical solutioning, and new revenue growth. In addition to competitive pay and commission, AT\&T offers paid training, comprehensive benefits, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, employee discounts, wellness programs, and career development resources designed to support long\-term success.

**Help make one\-on\-one tutoring work for Oakland children.**

Children Rising is hiring several **part\-time Program Coordinators** for the 2026–27 school year to support our literacy, math, and family engagement programs in Oakland elementary schools.

Program Coordinators are at the heart of our tutoring programs. They coordinate weekly tutoring clinics, support trained volunteer tutors working one\-on\-one with students, and help create an organized, encouraging environment where children can strengthen foundational reading and math skills.

If you enjoy working with children, are organized and encouraging, and want meaningful, hands\-on work in Oakland schools, we’d love to hear from you.

**Help make one\-on\-one tutoring work for Oakland children.**

Children Rising is hiring several **part\-time Program Coordinators** for the 2026–27 school year to support our literacy, math, and family engagement programs in Oakland elementary schools.

Program Coordinators are at the heart of our tutoring programs. They coordinate weekly tutoring clinics, support trained volunteer tutors working one\-on\-one with students, and help create an organized, encouraging environment where children can strengthen foundational reading and math skills.

If you enjoy working with children, are organized and encouraging, and want meaningful, hands\-on work in Oakland schools, we’d love to hear from you.

**What you’ll do**

* Coordinate two or more weekly tutoring clinics at Oakland school sites.
* Prepare tutoring spaces and materials so students and tutors are ready to work together.
* Pick up students from their classrooms and bring them to the tutoring clinic.
* Support volunteer tutors with scheduling, coaching, lesson planning, materials, encouragement, and student needs.

* Monitor student progress and tutor\-student relationships and work with program leadership to address challenges.
* Track attendance and maintain accurate student and tutor records.
* Update program information in Salesforce.
* Collaborate with our FamilyBridge team to help connect tutoring, classroom learning, and support at home.
* Participate in program meetings, staff meetings, and special events as needed.

* Two or more years of relevant education experience.
* A demonstrated ability and passion for working with children.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.
* Experience responding constructively to student behavior and learning challenges.
* Comfort with program evaluation, data tracking, and learning new systems.
* Experience working with diverse communities.
* Experience supporting English\-language learners is a plus.

* Part\-time, approximately **10–20 hours per week** during the academic year.
* Work takes place primarily at Oakland school sites, with some work at the Children Rising office and remotely.

Children Rising surrounds Oakland children with caring relationships and educational support so they can build stronger foundations in reading and math and greater confidence in themselves.

Through Succeeding by Reading, Path2Math, and FamilyBridge, students, families, volunteer tutors, schools, and community partners work together as part of a larger circle of care.

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**


We have an exciting full\-time opportunity for an **Admissions \& Program Operations Coordinator** at El Chante, our licensed 20\-bed residential substance use treatment program serving adult men in Oakland, Alameda County.


This role serves as the primary administrative liaison for all admissions into the residential Substance Use Disorder (SUD) program. This position is responsible for coordinating referrals, admissions, discharges, bed management, census reporting, and client appointment scheduling while ensuring compliance with agency, county, and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with the Clinical Program Manager, SUD Counselors, Resident Monitors, referral partners, county partners, medical and housing partners, and agency leadership, the Coordinator helps ensure seamless client movement through the program while maximizing residential capacity and supporting high\-quality service delivery. This collaboration ensures timely admissions, efficient bed management, effective communication, and a coordinated client experience from referral through discharge.


This is a full\-time, non\-exempt position working 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. The successful candidate will uphold and champion the agency's mission, vision, and values while contributing to a collaborative, inclusive, and client\-centered work environment.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Admissions/Intake Coordination:**
===================================

* Serves as the central point of contact for all referrals and admissions into the residential program.
* Receive and coordinate referrals from all approved referral sources.
* Schedule client intake appointments based on bed availability and program capacity.
* Confirm admission dates and times with referral partners.
* Coordinate client transportation and drop\-off times to El Chante, as appropriate.
* Communicate admission instructions to referral sources, clients, and family members when appropriate.
* Monitor the intake schedule to ensure efficient utilization of available beds.
* Collaborate with the Clinical Program Manager and clinical staff regarding admission priorities and clinical considerations.

**Resident Census and Discharge Management:**
=============================================

* Maintains accurate and up\-to\-date information regarding all client admissions and discharges.
* Tracks all scheduled admissions.
* Monitors anticipated discharge dates.
* Coordinates discharge information with internal staff and referral partners.
* Updates admission and discharge logs.
* Communicates changes in bed availability to appropriate stakeholders.
* Maintains accurate census information to support operational planning.

**Bed Management and Census Reporting:**
========================================

* Maintain accurate daily census information and complete required reporting related to residential capacity.
* Completing daily bed surveys.
* Maintaining the Daily Bed Day Sheet.
* Tracking occupied and available beds.
* Monitoring program census and bed utilization.
* Ensuring bed tracking documentation is accurate and submitted within required timeframes.
* Working with leadership to maximize occupancy while maintaining appropriate clinical placement.

**Client Scheduling and Administrative Coordination:**
======================================================

* Manage the daily administrative schedule for residential clients to ensure appointments are coordinated and communicated effectively.
* Coordinate and maintain schedules for:
* Court appearances.
* Medical appointments.
* Primary care visits.
* Dental appointments.
* Specialty medical appointments.
* Medication Assisted Treatment (MAT) clinic visits.
* Behavioral health appointments.
* Other approved external appointments.
* Communicates daily schedules with Resident Monitors, SUD Counselors, and the Clinical Program Manager to support transportation planning, clinical programming, and continuity of care.

### **Administrative Support Responsibilities**

* Provide timely, professional administrative support during scheduled hours, including monitoring and responding to phone calls, email, Slack, and stakeholder inquiries.
* Serve as a primary administrative point of contact for El Chante, providing information to clients, referral partners, community agencies, and other stakeholders and supporting positive community relationships.
* Support admissions and census management, including responding to referrals, maintaining intake and census records, preparing admission packets, coordinating communication related to admissions, transfers, and discharges, and maintaining referral and tracking systems.
* Maintain accurate program, client, staff, and reporting records in systems including Smart Care, Clinician’s Gateway, Salesforce, Paycom, Google Drive, and other applicable databases. Generate required reports and support billing, DATAR, Medi\-Cal eligibility, service\-hour, bed\-day, and other contract reporting requirements.
* Maintain accurate and compliant client and personnel documentation, including charts, licenses, certifications, TB records, training records, staff IDs, NPI/CAQH information, and system access. Ensure documentation meets agency, contract, HIPAA, and regulatory requirements and coordinate with HR and QA as needed.
* Support staff onboarding and ongoing administrative needs, including system access, required training and certifications, Clinician’s Gateway authorizations, and training on internal systems and procedures.
* Coordinate and track facility operations, maintenance, supplies, deliveries, mail, faxes, equipment, technology, and maintenance requests to support a safe, organized, and fully operational residential environment.
* Support the therapeutic milieu by engaging appropriately with residents and assisting program staff with administrative and operational needs as appropriate.

**Oncology Account Manager \- Pacific NW**


**Cycle Company:** Cycle Pharmaceuticals Inc

**Salary Range:** $170,000 \- $200,000 depending on experience.


**Position Summary:** This is a full\-time position working within our oncology sales team.

  


**The Opportunity**



We're looking for an experienced and passionate Oncology Account Manager to join our sales team to help drive our mission forward within the oncology space. This is a unique opportunity to be part of something truly meaningful at a pivotal moment in our expansion.



These are foundational roles within our newest therapeutic area, giving you the chance to make a real impact and support patients living with rare hematologic and oncologic conditions.



You'll join a driven and fast\-growing organization with a strong track record within the oncology pharma space. You'll have the opportunity to lead engagement with HCPs and clinics across your territory, educate on disease and treatment pathways, and support access via our specialty pharmacy and/or Cycle Vita patient hub. You'll also collaborate cross\-functionally to help drive launch success and build strong relationships across the haematology/oncology landscape.

  


**Our Company**



At Cycle Pharmaceuticals, we believe that **Every Single Patient Matters**. This is at the heart of why we work and were looking for people to join our team who share our vision. We know that life\-changing treatments need life\-improving product support to match, because when you put the two together, great things can happen.



At Cycle Pharma, we focus on providing treatments and services for patients with neurological, rare metabolic, and rare immunological conditions, most of which are genetic conditions. Some of our patients are diagnosed with a rare disease at birth, others are affected later in life, and some can spend years trying to get diagnosed. No matter what stage our patients or their caregivers are at, we strive to provide them with the support they require. If you want to know more about what we do then, why not check out our website below and look at some of our patient stories:



Patient Stories \- Cycle Pharma

  


**What you will be doing**

* Identify, engage, and partner with key opinion leaders to support peer\-to\-peer education and community outreach.

* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Market Access, Marketing, and Field Leadership to align on strategy and field insights.
* Ensure accurate CRM documentation, maintain compliance, and develop and deliver quarterly business plans tailored to your market dynamics.

  


**What you'll bring**


* Bachelor's degree required.

* Proven successful field\-based sales experience in biopharmaceuticals.
* Proven ability to meet/exceed performance goals.
* Collaborative, ethical, and proactive team player.
* Strong communication and CRM/data skills.
* Willingness to travel up to 70%.

**What makes this role special**


* Be part of building something new from the ground up.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Open Standard**


Open Standard is on a mission to build the world's best money, starting with the US dollar. We believe money should move the way data does: instantly, globally, at any hour, in any amount. Today, financial transactions are hindered by delays, fees, and inefficiencies that every business must bear. We’re here to change that.


Our flagship product, Open USD, is a stablecoin designed for the internet: programmable, global, and built to reward the businesses that champion its adoption. Launched in close partnership with industry leaders like Stripe, Visa, Mastercard, Coinbase, and Shopify, Open Standard already has over 200 top companies in its network. Our lean team is based in San Francisco and New York and is led by Zach Abrams, who co\-founded Bridge (acquired by Stripe for $1\.1B) and previously led product at Brex, Coinbase, and Square.


Money is the world's most foundational product. Join us to help redefine it.

**Your role**


As Open Standard’s first Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in bringing the world’s largest banks, payment companies, and fintechs onto the Open USD platform. From the day a partner signs, you will become their main point of contact, guiding them through integration, launch, and every stage of future growth. You’ll collaborate closely with product teams at our founding partners, including Stripe, Coinbase, Visa, and Mastercard, whose customers will be among the first to use Open USD.


This is an exciting opportunity to help shape Open Standard’s partner experience, take our earliest partnerships live, and convert a network of signed partners into a community of deeply engaged adopters.

**What you'll do**

* Launch new partners quickly by coordinating across Legal, Product, Compliance, and integration teams, ensuring launches happen in days, not weeks
* Develop tailored growth plans with each partner: define how Open USD fits their business, project transaction volumes for the first year, and identify key success drivers; lead quarterly reviews with partner leadership
* Connect partners within the network to foster collaboration and unlock new value as more companies adopt Open USD
* Serve as the single point of contact for partners after signing: manage launch announcements, handle reporting questions, and involve internal teams (Finance, Legal, Product) as needed
* Own the partner demand picture: build and maintain partner\-level forecasts that guide Liquidity, Finance, and Product planning
* Continuously improve our onboarding and product by turning every partner’s experience into future best practices and enhancements

**You may be a good fit if you**

* Have experience onboarding partners at a payments network, stablecoin issuer, or banking\-as\-a\-service platform
* Have worked in a network or marketplace business where facilitating participant connections was part of your role
* Possess enough technical fluency to lead integration calls without needing a dedicated solutions engineer

**Strong candidates may also have**

* Experience onboarding partners at a payments network, stablecoin issuer, or banking\-as\-a\-service platform (if not already mentioned above)
* Additional technical expertise to independently own integration conversations

**Logistics**

* **Location:** San Francisco or New York, hybrid with a mix of in\-office and remote days

**Come work with us**


Open Standard is headquartered in San Francisco with an office in New York. We’re a small, senior, and entrepreneurial team with high autonomy and trust. If our mission excites you and you meet most of the qualifications, we want to hear from you.


Compensation Range: $175K \- $210K

jobs.description:
**Location**
------------


San Francisco


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


On\-site


**Department**
--------------


Marketing


  
**We are an applied AI lab building end\-to\-end software agents.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------


We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.


Our team is extremely talent\-dense. Among our founding team, we have world\-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.


Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real\-world tasks, apply to join us.


**The Role**


We’re looking for a hands\-on marketer to turn Cognition’s differentiated technology and customer impact into enterprise campaigns that drive pipeline and sales.


You’ll create content and experiences that influence every key stakeholder in an enterprise purchase—from engineering champions and technical evaluators to executive sponsors and economic buyers. Your work will help customers understand what’s possible, evaluate our technology, build the business case, and move confidently toward adoption.


You’ll own campaigns from idea through execution and promotion, bringing together the right message, format, audience, and channels. This role combines strong storytelling, commercial judgment, and the ability to ship quickly.


**What You’ll Do**


* **Build integrated campaigns around our most important themes.** Partner with Product Marketing to translate Cognition’s positioning, key messaging, and differentiation into campaigns that create demand and advance enterprise deals.
* **Create content across the buying journey.** Develop ebooks, research, webinars, demo experiences, practical templates and guides, workshops, business\-case tools, and other formats that help buyers move from initial interest through evaluation and purchase.
* **Reach the full buying group.** Address the distinct priorities of engineering leaders, developers, IT and security stakeholders, and business executives—with the right depth, evidence, and next step for each audience.
* **Make campaigns relevant across verticals.** Translate broad themes into industry\-specific use cases, challenges, and customer outcomes, partnering with Enterprise Demand and Sales on priority segments and accounts.
* **Own the promotion strategy.** Build distribution into every campaign from the start. Coordinate paid, email, web, social, partner, field, and sales activation with the teams responsible for each channel.
* **Bring technical differentiation to life.** Work with Product Marketing, engineers, technical experts, and customers to turn complex capabilities into credible stories and demonstrations of enterprise impact.
* **Execute from brief to launch.** Own campaign plans, content development, production, timelines, and follow\-up. Write and build directly, bringing in internal experts and external resources where needed.
* **Optimize for pipeline and revenue.** Partner with Revenue Operations and Sales to measure buying\-group engagement, qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, and sales outcomes. Use those insights to improve the next campaign.

**What Success Looks Like**


Your campaigns consistently reach the right buyers, make Cognition’s differentiation tangible, and help Sales create and win enterprise opportunities. You build a repeatable approach to turning our strongest ideas, product capabilities, and customer evidence into programs that produce measurable commercial results.


**You Should Be**


* A track record of building and executing integrated campaigns for enterprise B2B technology buyers.
* Strong content development and writing skills, with examples of work you personally took from concept to launch.
* Experience connecting content, distribution, and sales follow\-up to measurable pipeline outcomes.
* An understanding of complex enterprise buying groups and how their information needs change throughout a deal.
* The ability to move between an executive business narrative and detailed product or use\-case content.
* Strong project ownership: you can coordinate multiple contributors, make decisions, and ship high\-quality work quickly.
* A practical approach to experimentation, including using AI tools to accelerate research, production, and iteration.

**Bonus Points**


* Experience marketing developer tools, AI, infrastructure, or other technical enterprise products.
* Comfort creating technical content and partnering closely with engineers or solutions teams.
* Experience building vertical campaigns, technical webinars, demo\-led programs, or content that supports active enterprise opportunities.

Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process \- please let us know if you need any.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager, Mid-Market
jobs.description:
**About Hyperbound**
--------------------


Deals are messy. Multiple stakeholders, hours of calls, and endless emails. At Hyperbound, we're building the AI Agent that will help sales teams untangle that mess.


Hyperbound is the Revenue Activation Platform: an agentic OS for sales that connects what happens to what should happen next.  

  

We came out of YC S23 and went viral with Voice Agents that reps could call to put their skills to the test. Today, we’re building AI that understands sales conversations, coaches in real time, reasons across deals, and takes action to move them forward.


We are trusted by companies like LinkedIn, Amazon, Bloomberg, Supabase, Monday.com, Notion, and Vanta. We raised a $15M Series A in October 2025, grew ARR 5× over the past year, and are growing nearly 20% month over month.

**About the role**
------------------


You'll own a book of 25 to 40 mid\-market customers ($20k to $100k\+ ARR) and be their day\-to\-day owner at Hyperbound. Your job is to get them live, get their reps using the product.

**What we need from you**
-------------------------

* **Technical depth**: You can debug, trace and reproduce a bug. You go to product or engineering when a problem is below the UI, not because you didn't want to look.
* **Relationship instinct**: You know the key people at every account, they know you, and they message you before they message anyone else. You understand what each customer is trying to fix and you build the plan around that.
* **Ownership**: When something goes wrong, you name the problem, and start solving it. You only pull in more people if required.
* **Conviction**: You push back. When a customer wants to skip the rollout plan, run the wrong cadence, or launch to the whole sales org on day one, you tell them why it won't work and sell them on the approach that will. Customers respect solutions that are sold to them, not handed over. You own the implementation and the outcome, not just the setup.

**Highly preferred**
--------------------

* Background in sales enablement, revenue enablement, or GTM ops. You've rolled out a tool or a methodology to a sales team before and know what it takes to get reps to actually use it.
* Experience implementing or administering Hyperbound or a similar sales coaching platform.

**What your regular Thursday looks like:**
------------------------------------------

* **Implementation**: Own the project plan from kickoff to first live cohort. Rollout design, integrations setup, SSO and SCIM, admin training, launch date.
* **Adoption**: Regular check\-ins, usage reviews, feature demos, and behaviour\-change plays that get reps practising and managers coaching.
* **First\-line technical support**: Discovery on the call, reproduce the issue, file a clean ticket. Solve what can be solved in the UI or a playbook yourself.
* **Voice of the customer**: Own feedback from your accounts and make sure it reaches the product.
* **Health monitoring**: Watch active users, caller counts, and implementation milestones so you act on a slipping account weeks before the renewal conversation, not during it.
* **Commercial signals**: Spot expansion and renewal risk, log it, and hand it to the account manager who owns pricing and paper.
* **Responsiveness**: Fast on Slack, tickets, and email.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* A tag\-team job. You go to customer meetings alone. Bringing a second person is the exception.
* A sales job. Retention comes first. Expansion signals get logged and handed over, not chased. A commercial role. You don't price, negotiate, or own renewal paper. You will be paired with an expansion Account manager who will take care of that.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Comfortable with the technical side: reading logs, reproducing bugs, working through configuration, and explaining a technical issue clearly to both a customer and an engineer. You don't need to be an engineer.
* You broadly understand how a sales team runs: quotas, onboarding, coaching cadences.
* You remove blockers yourself rather than routing customers to another team.
* You can run around 40 accounts and treat them differently on purpose.

**Interview Plan**
------------------

* 30 min call with James, Recruiter
* 30 min call with Keshav, Product Lead
* Take home exercise (1\-3 hours)
* Take home exercise review call (45 min)
* Final interview with Co Founders and team

**Compensation and Benefits**

* $130K\-$160k OTE
* Series A equity
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* Free lunch and dinner in the office
* Commuter benefits


We move fast, from first conversation to offer in 1\-2 weeks
