jobs.title: Business Development Representative (Enterprise)
jobs.description:
**About Within**  

  

Tldr on us: **Series B, $91M raised, 7x growth** last year.


Digital Transformation gave rise to a $600B consulting Industry. AI Transformation will be 10x bigger and will be delivered through agents. We built that.


Our AI discovers how work actually happens across every team and application, Structures it into a living Context Graph, and Improves it continuously.


ServiceNow mapped 900\+ processes in 9 days. DoorDash captured 3,800\+ finance operations in 14 weeks. That's not a project. That's compounding intelligence.


OpenAI, Google, DoorDash, and Stripe use Within to transform how they transform. We shipped GPT\-4 document chat within 12 hours of OpenAI's API launch.


We move fast, reward agency, and care deeply about our customers, our team, and our mission.


**About the Role**


This is the first dedicated business development role on our Enterprise team, and one of the first at Within. Our Account Executives currently prospect their own patches, which is the single biggest constraint on how fast we add new enterprise logos. You'll take that on: running outbound across a defined book of Enterprise AEs instead of owning a patch of your own.


Your territory: companies with $500M\+ in revenue in software, professional services, financial services, healthcare and manufacturing. Your job is coverage and speed \- finding accounts the moment they become winnable, reaching the right person first, and building net\-new pipeline across multiple patches rather than going deep on a handful of logos.


You'll have Salesforce, Hubspot, Gong, Clay, Sales Navigator, a documented ICP and sales process, and proof points that already get people to lean in. Your job is to turn that into a real outbound motion for sustained revenue growth.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and maintain the target account list across the Enterprise segment, against a $500M\+ revenue floor. Know which accounts are live, which are parked, and why.
* Track the signals that predict a deal: an active or imminent ERP, CRM or HRIS migration (S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, Workday, Salesforce), post\-M\&A integration, a new transformation mandate, or a new Finance or Transformation executive in their first 180 days.
* Reach out proactively to senior executives across Technology and Transformation, plus GTM, IT and Finance. Internal Audit and Compliance isn't a viable entry point on its own.
* Source the process excellence and operations managers who don't hold budget but convert 3\-5x better than broad campaigns, and fill our Change Agent Bootcamps.
* Write outreach a CFO actually reads. Close to half of won deals compete against doing nothing, not another vendor.
* Qualify every meeting to a real bar: confirmed authority, confirmed need, an identified use case, and a discovery call booked with the AE.
* Run account planning with our Enterprise AEs and keep handoffs clean.
* Help build the function: choose the sequencer, set the cadence, write the objection handling, and feed what's working back to the team.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You…**

* Have 4\+ years of professional experience, including 2\+ years in an SDR, BDR or inside sales role selling SaaS or AI solutions, with a quota you've consistently beaten.
* Have prospected into $500M\+ enterprise accounts and can hold structure across hundreds of accounts and multiple AEs at once.
* Are comfortable opening conversations with CFOs, CIOs and VPs of Transformation, in writing and on the phone.
* Do the research. Personalization means knowing a company is eighteen months into a stalled Oracle Fusion program, not swapping in a company name.
* Write short, specific, no\-filler copy.
* Use AI daily in your own workflow, not just talk about using it.
* Are fluent in Salesforce and modern prospecting tools.

**Strong Candidates May Also…**

* Have sold into finance, transformation, process excellence or shared services organizations.
* Have built an outbound motion from scratch, or rebuilt one.
* Be adept at Apollo, Gong, Sales Navigator, Salesforce or similar tools.
* Use LLMs like Claude/ChatGPT/Grok as part of your daily workflow

**What Within Values in This Hire**


We’re not just hiring a title. We’re hiring a builder. Here’s what matters to us:

* **History of Achievement**: You have a track record of setting ambitious goals and hitting them. Quota attainment isn’t a hope \- it’s a habit.
* **Intellectually Curious**: You learn everything about your customers, their industry, and the product \- then use that knowledge to delight prospects and win trust.
* **Appetite for Closing**: Passionate about winning. Comfortable asking people to make decisions right now. You drive urgency without creating pressure.
* **Coachable**: You have the desire and ability to take feedback, internalize it, and get measurably better \- fast.
* **Scrappy Builder**: Proven track record of building, not just managing. Hungry for the next level and willing to do the unglamorous work to get there.
* **AI Fluent**: You possess a deep understanding and proven track record of using a variety of AI tools across all aspects of the sales process \- from discovery to ROI to close. You use AI to sharpen prospecting, manage your time, stay organized, and prioritize your day to maximize results. Building your own Agents and Skills is a plus.
* **Loyalty \& Resilience**: Commitment to prior employers. We want people who dig in when things get hard, not people who optimize for optionality.
* **Customer Obsessed**: Entrepreneurial spirit, strong opinions, bias for action. Cares deeply about customer outcomes.
* **Technical Translator**: Can make the complex feel simple. Moves fluidly between deep technical conversations and business\-value story telling

 **Location \& Travel**


This role is based in San Francisco, in the office four days a week under our standard in\-office policy. Outreach happens by email and phone from a desk, with no customer travel neccessary.

**Benefits:**
----------

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (SF)
jobs.description:
**About Sequel**
----------------


Every company is becoming a media company. The problem is that most of them are building their audience on someone else's platform, and handing their best data to it.


Sequel fixes that. We power webinars, virtual events, and video programs that live directly on a company's own website, so every registration, view, question, and click becomes first\-party data they own. Then we put that data to work. With our new AI agents, Sequel helps marketing teams create programs faster, turn engaged viewers into pipeline, and grow their audience without adding headcount.

  

We call it \- **Human Moments, Agentic Momentum.**

  

We're trusted by 300\+ customers, some of the world's fastest growing companies like Cisco, Zoominfo, Clay, ElevenLabs, Newsweek, etc. are building their audience with Sequel. We've kept zero churn among our mid market \& enterprise customers, and we've tripled our growth multiple times. We're VC\-backed and recently closed a new round of funding to double down on AI and scale the team.

  

**BDR @ Sequel.io \- SF Hub**
-----------------------------


The Business Development Representative (BDR) plays a critical role in Sequel's go\-to\-market engine, generating qualified pipeline for the sales team through outbound prospecting, warmbound lead activation, field events, and warm introductions. The BDR is often the first human touchpoint for prospects, helping them understand Sequel's value and guiding them toward a well\-qualified demo with our Account Executives.


We already have two BDRs on the team and we're growing. One of our BDRs is now transitioning into an Account Executive role after crushing goals for 18 months.


We're looking for someone who is hungry, energized by our pace of growth, obsessed with hitting targets, and constantly learning. This role requires an experimentation mindset and the willingness to persevere through rejection, paired with the ability to build rapport fast, over the phone, over email, or in person, with buyers who start out skeptical because they don't want to be sold to.


You don't need a lot of prior experience, but you do need to learn quickly and be enthusiastic about building systems with AI. You'll join an existing team that's performing and hitting quota, working hard but having fun, with real opportunities for internal advancement.

  

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Outbound prospecting across cold calling, cold email, LinkedIn outreach, social selling, and multi\-threading into target accounts
* Research on accounts and contacts to craft targeted sequences aligned to buyer personas (Marketing, Demand Gen, MOps)
* Warm introductions sourced from Sequel executives, investors, and partners, converted into qualified conversations
* Warmbound lead activation: demo requests, webinar attendees, content downloads, and website engagement signals, qualified using SPICED\-aligned discovery
* No\-show and warmbound re\-engagement through structured call, email, and occasional SMS workflows
* Representing Sequel at industry events and trade shows, prospecting on\-site and soliciting product demos
* Demo scheduling and handoff to Account Executives, with clean SPICED discovery notes and CRM hygiene
* Pipeline generation and reporting against weekly and monthly demo booking targets
* Experimentation across messaging, cadences, subject lines, and channels, including AI\-assisted testing to improve cold call and cold email results, with learnings documented for the team

  

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Hunger to hit and exceed targets, energized rather than daunted by a fast\-growing, fast\-changing company
* Natural rapport\-builder who can earn trust quickly with skeptical buyers, by phone, email, or in person
* High curiosity about the product itself, with a willingness to dig in and learn how Sequel compares to competitors in a crowded market
* Comfort with experimentation and the resilience to keep going through rejection
* Genuine interest in using AI tools day to day and learning new ones as they emerge
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Little to no prior experience required, but a fast learner who takes coaching well

**Why join us \+ Perks:**
-------------------------

* **Real ownership from day one.** This is a high\-impact role where your work ships, customers feel it, and no two days look the same.
* **Remote\-first, with hubs in New York and San Francisco.** We run on strong async communication and a collaborative, low\-ego team. Work from anywhere, connect in person at our NY and SF hubs, and join us for our annual team offsite (this year we were in Barcelona!), kick\-offs, and weekly virtual hang\-outs.
* **A seat at the table.** Everyone has a voice here. We actively ask for feedback and act on it.
* **Built to be AI\-native.** You'll work with the best AI tools and learn how to use them to do the best work of your career.
* **Comprehensive benefits.** Health, dental, vision, 401(k), parental leave, and a generous fitness stipend. Gotta stay healthy \- mind and body!
* **Generous time off.** 20 days of PTO a year, plus a winter company shutdown so the whole team can fully recharge, and extra days off for the special moments in your life, like your birthday.
* **Room to grow.** A clear path for growth and development across the company, with leaders who invest in your career.

  

Compensation Range: $80K \- $120K

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Stable**
----------------


Our mission is to make it simple to headquarter any business on the internet. Today, we provide companies with a business address and a dashboard to manage their physical mail online. Over 15,000\+ companies like Brex, Doordash, and Gusto use Stable to automate their mailroom and act as their permanent business address with the IRS, state, and vendors.


The rules that regulate US entities were written in the 1800s. Stable abstracts these antiquated requirements with tools that empower modern companies to move forward faster.


These rules don't make sense for the way we work today — work takes place in the cloud and businesses are no longer tied to physical proximity or geography.


We’re on a mission to fix the broken system of entity management. Starting with business addresses and mail, we’re abstracting the complex, archaic systems that make company\-building painful and turning them into delightful experiences — so that modern businesses have the tools they need to move forward faster.


We're backed by leading Silicon Valley investors like Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Shakti, Hustle Fund, and founders from companies like Lattice, Apartment List, and FlexJobs.


Our business is at an inflection point. We’re growing quickly with a product people love and we’ve proven we can service companies of all stages and industries — from early\-stage startups to publicly traded companies in industries like technology, logistics, and property management.


This is an opportunity to join an early\-stage startup as one of the first employees and do work that directly impacts the future of how companies are built.

**Role**
--------


Stable services companies from newly incorporated sole\-proprietorships all the way to the S\&P 500, and we are hiring a **Sales Development Representative** to proactively engage with high\-value prospects and drive new business. This is an exciting opportunity to grow Stable’s pipeline while helping new customers streamline their operations.

**As an SDR**, you will identify, research, and engage with potential customers who could benefit from Stable’s solutions. Your role will be critical in driving awareness, generating leads, and building the foundation for Stable’s sales success.

* **Be a proactive partner for outbound prospects** — Instead of waiting for customers to come to us, you’ll use a mix of personalized outreach and automated tools to spark meaningful conversations with prospects, understanding their pain points and positioning Stable as the best solution for their needs.
* **Identify customer challenges and connect them with the right solutions** — You’ll uncover prospects’ operational challenges and business needs, qualifying opportunities to pass along to the Sales team.
* **Build and refine outbound processes** — Customers from all sorts of industries need a mail solution. You’ll work to identify the best personas, messaging, and channels for outbound outreach, developing scalable processes and playbooks to optimize the outbound sales function.
* **Apply Creative Approaches to Prospect Engagement** – Leverage innovative strategies to connect with prospects, using personalized messaging, thoughtful outreach, and unique tactics to stand out in a crowded market. From crafting engaging email campaigns to exploring unconventional touchpoints, you’ll find ways to capture attention and build meaningful relationships with potential customers.


This is an opportunity to join an early\-stage startup as one of the first employees and have a direct impact on the future of how companies manage mail operations.

  

### **What you value**

* **Be human:** Lead with empathy, act with authenticity, and enjoy what you do.
* **Stay curious:** Invent novel solutions by asking why, listening, and tinkering.
* **Act quickly with purpose:** Focus on what matters, iteratively improve, and move urgently toward the goal.
* **Insist on exceptional outcomes:** Strive for excellence and take ownership of the outcomes you deliver.
* **Exceed customer expectations:** Create delightful experiences with each interaction.

  

### **What you'll do**

* Make a great first impression with customers by crafting compelling outbound emails, calls, and social messages to generate interest in Stable’s products.
* Conduct detailed research to identify and prioritize high\-potential target accounts and decision\-makers.
* Qualify outbound leads by understanding their needs, challenges, and fit for Stable’s solutions.
* Work closely with the Sales and Marketing teams to align outreach strategies and improve pipeline generation.
* Experiment in identifying the best personas and channels for engaging with new customers and refine processes to maximize outbound effectiveness.

  

### **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Sales, Business Development, Account Management, or a related field.
* 0\-1 year of experience with a preference for candidates that have expressed interest in sales or business development either professionally or during university
* Proven ability to conduct thoughtful and personalized outreach across email, phone, and social channels.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills
* Comfortable working within a fast\-paced, scaling sales environment.

  

### **What we offer**

* Competitive salary and generous equity
* Unlimited paid vacation
* Healthcare benefits
* Home office set\-up
* Work from anywhere within US time zones (GMT\-5 to GMT\-10\)
* Opportunities to shape the future of Stable and grow into leadership roles

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant**



The Executive Assistant provides high\-level administrative and operational support to coDesign's executive team, acting as a trusted right hand who keeps leadership organized, informed, and focused on strategic priorities. This role requires sound judgment, discretion with sensitive information, and the ability to anticipate needs before they arise. The ideal candidate has several years of experience supporting senior executives, ideally within a fast\-paced, growing company.


**Roles and Responsibilities**


**1\.0 Executive Support**


* Manage complex, overlapping calendars for multiple executives, proactively resolving scheduling conflicts and prioritizing time against each executive's strategic goals — and against each other's competing demands.
* Serve as a central point of coordination across the executive team, flagging when priorities conflict and helping executives (or their delegate) make trade\-off decisions on time and attention.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements for multiple executives, including itineraries, accommodations, and expense reconciliation.
* Prepare, proofread, and format correspondence, presentations, board materials, and internal communications on behalf of the executive team.
* Screen and prioritize incoming communications across executives, exercising discretion on what requires which executive's attention versus delegation.
* Act as a liaison between the executive team and internal teams, clients, and external partners, representing the executive team professionally at all times.
* Leverage AI tools to streamline drafting, scheduling, research, and follow\-up tasks, helping the executive team move faster without sacrificing quality or accuracy.


**2\.0 Meeting \& Project Coordination**


* Plan and coordinate leadership meetings, offsites, and board meetings, including agenda development, materials preparation, and minute\-taking.
* Track action items from executive meetings and follow up to ensure timely completion.
* Support cross\-functional projects led by the executive team, helping keep initiatives on schedule and stakeholders aligned.
* Manage and maintain executive tasks and cross\-functional projects in ClickUp, ensuring action items, deadlines, and priorities stay visible and up to date.


**3\.0 Financial \& Administrative Support**


* Process executive expense reports and reconcile corporate card activity in line with company policy.
* Assist with budget tracking for executive\-led initiatives as needed.
* Maintain confidential files, contracts, and records with a high degree of accuracy and discretion.


**4\.0 People and Performance**


* Always comply with company policies and procedures and continually display company values.
* Actively participate in forums, training programs and education as directed by the company.
* Actively work towards achieving individual and business objectives.
* Continually work towards building and maintaining productive and sound working relationships with all internal and external stakeholders.


**5\.0 Office \& Operational Support**


* Partner with the broader operations team on office logistics, vendor coordination, and special projects as needed.
* Assist colleagues whenever there is an opportunity to do so.


**Qualifications and Experience**


* 5\+ years' experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C\-suite or senior leadership.
* Advanced Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365 skills (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder calendars and travel logistics.
* Demonstrated discretion in handling confidential and sensitive information.
* Comfortable adopting and using AI tools to increase efficiency in daily tasks.


**Person Specification**


* Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.
* Sound judgment and the ability to make decisions independently on behalf of executives.
* Accuracy and attention to detail, even under time pressure.
* Sense of urgency, deadline driven with exceptional organizational and multi\-tasking skills.
* Comfortable managing competing priorities across multiple executives without letting any one person's urgency crowd out the others.
* Motivated individual with the ability to work both independently and within a team.


**About coDesign**CoDesign is a workspace design and build start\-up looking for awesome talent who want to unleash their potential and grow in their career/ life. We offer our clients in the San Francisco / Bay Area a new, far better, and simpler way to a workspace. This role offers an excellent platform for expansion of responsibility and valuable insight into all projects; a young and energetic team to work with; and an exciting business model experiencing explosive growth! Our culture is built on collaboration and a passion for designing and building awesome workspaces.

**Summary**

The Operations Coordinator supports day‑to‑day logistics and order fulfillment activities while serving as a key point of contact for customers. This role is responsible for processing B2B and B2C orders, coordinating with warehouses and 3PL partners, maintaining accurate data in ERP/WMS systems, and assisting with inventory, documentation, and billing support. · Coordinating operational tasks between the customer to warehouse teams.

· Documenting order data, inventory, and accounting details into systems.

**Typical Day**

A typical day for the Operations Coordinator begins at 8:00 a.m., reviewing incoming orders, checking inventory levels, and coordinating with the warehouse team to ensure orders are picked, packed, and shipped accurately. Throughout the day, they update order information in the ERP/WMS system, monitor shipments, and respond to customer and client inquiries via email or phone. They work closely with internal teams to resolve any order, inventory, or carrier issues, assist with shipping documentation, and support basic billing activities as needed. The day also includes tracking data, flagging discrepancies, and contributing to small process improvements before wrapping up tasks and handoffs by 5:00 p.m.

**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Rippling’s channel ecosystem is a core revenue engine. We are hiring an **Event Marketing Manager** to own a segment for event marketing end\-to\-end: strategy, budget, and hands\-on execution.  

You will set the vision for how we activate and nurture national and regional partners, reach their HR and finance clients and prospects, design repeatable playbooks, and personally run the programs that turn partners into advocates and advocates into revenue. You will partner closely with Sales, Revenue Ops, and Corporate Events to ensure every dollar and every activation ties to measurable outcomes.**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Own segment events strategy and budget end\-to\-end**. Build the annual and monthly events plan, manage the full portfolio, and reallocate spend based on ROI signals.
* **Codify repeatable segment playbooks**. Create sales activation frameworks and plays, regional toolkits, and QA checklists so programs are easy to replicate and scale with quality.
* **Execute flagship programs**. Plan and run high\-impact events and always\-on campaigns from brief to high ROI follow\-up strategies to post\-mortem, including vendor sourcing, contract negotiation, timelines and onsite excellence.
* **Own campaign and CRM operations**. Build, launch and maintain Salesforce and Outreach campaigns that attribute every touch to pipeline and revenue, with Sendoso acceleration where applicable.
* **Measure, learn, and optimize**. Define KPIs, stand up dashboards, publish retros, and use insights to shift budget towards top\-performing formats.
* **Cross\-functional leadership without formal authority**. Align Channel AEs, sales leadership, extended field marketing, demand gen, and marketing ops on priorities, calendars, and measurement. Remove blockers and keep events on track.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 4\-6 years in field, channel, or demand gen marketing, owning strategy, budget, and hands\-on execution in high\-growth SaaS.
* Proven ability to build and scale repeatable partner playbooks that drive measurable pipeline and revenue.
* Financial and operational rigor, including vendor management and budget optimization
* Salesforce and ideally Outreach and Sendoso experience, with the ability to architect campaigns that drive revenue.
* Executive communication skills, strong stakeholder management, and comfort operating with high autonomy.
* Creative problem solver who ships quickly, learns fast, and continuously raises the bar.

jobs.title: Shipping & Logistics Coordinator – Apparel
jobs.description:
Seeking an experienced Shipping \& Logistics Coordinator to join our growing team. This is a hands\-on, fast\-paced role responsible for managing retailer accounts and overseeing the order lifecycle from order entry and allocation through shipping and completion.

The ideal candidate will have previous experience in the **apparel, footwear, or accessories industry**, a strong understanding of shipping and logistics, and experience working with major retailers, 3PL warehouses, and ERP systems.

This position requires someone who is highly organized, comfortable managing a high volume of orders, and able to take ownership of assigned accounts while working cross\-functionally with sales, production, finance, warehouses, and outside sales representatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage assigned retailer accounts from order entry through final shipment
* Process order entry, allocation, shipping, and pick tickets
* Coordinate closely with 3PL warehouses to ensure accurate and timely fulfillment
* Manage retailer\-specific routing, shipping, and compliance requirements
* Work with both EDI and non\-EDI accounts and process various EDI transaction types
* Coordinate shipments for major retailers, off\-price accounts, and specialty/boutique stores
* Manage both factored and non\-factored customer accounts
* Review and analyze inventory to support order allocation and fulfillment
* Work closely with in\-house sales teams and outside sales representatives
* Process credit card transactions and issue RMAs as needed
* Communicate directly with store owners, buyers, and customers when necessary
* Work cross\-functionally with sales, production, finance, and warehouse teams
* Troubleshoot order, inventory, shipping, and fulfillment issues
* Manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment

**Required Qualifications:**

* Previous experience in **apparel, footwear, or accessories is required**
* Previous ERP system experience is required
* Experience with order entry, allocation, shipping, pick tickets, and 3PL warehouses
* Basic EDI knowledge and experience processing EDI transactions
* Experience shipping to major retailers
* Understanding of retailer\-specific routing and compliance requirements
* Experience handling both factored and non\-factored accounts
* Experience working with high order volumes
* Experience working with both inside and outside sales representatives
* Experience processing credit card transactions and issuing RMAs
* Ability to analyze and understand inventory
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and communication skills
* Ability to shift priorities as business needs change
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned accounts

**Preferred Experience:**

* A2000 experience strongly preferred
* JOOR experience is a plus
* In\-house EDI experience is a plus
* Customer service experience is a plus
* Experience shipping to specialty and boutique stores is a plus
* Experience working with major department store and off\-price accounts, including **Nordstrom, Saks, Macy’s, Costco, Ross, TJX, Bealls, and similar retailers**, is strongly preferred

**About the Role:**

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing company in a hands\-on logistics and EDI position within the denim, knitwear, outerwear, and swim categories.

In 2025, our company shipped more than $50 million in merchandise, and this position plays an important role in supporting that volume. The successful candidate must be comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment, wearing multiple hats, and managing a significant monthly and annual order volume.

The person in this role will be expected to take full ownership of their assigned retailer accounts and manage each order through completion while communicating effectively across departments.

**Compensation:** $65,000\+ annually, depending on experience  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Work Location:** On\-site in New York, NY  
**Remote:** No

Pay: From $65,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

* Ability to gain consistent access \& develop strong, professional relationships for scientific exchange and promotion with healthcare providers in institutions, IDNs and academic centers
* Effective administrator who efficiently manages time, CRM tool, resources, and workload
* Effective verbal and written communication skills and organizational abilities
* Ability to travel within territory on a regular basis which will include frequent overnight and weekend travel

jobs.title: GCP Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III), you will support Public Sector customers with cloud adoption, operational planning, technical issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination. Working alongside senior team members, you will help maintain account health and coordinate activities across customer and delivery partner teams. You will contribute to reliable, secure cloud outcomes in complex public\-sector environments. This remote role is available to candidates who can work from within the continental United States.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/21/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III) on the AI \& Engineering team, you will be responsible for:
  

* Coordinate technical activities across assigned customer workstreams and track customer issues, risks, dependencies, action items, and upcoming milestones.
* Collaborate with client Support, Product Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and customer escalations.
* Support customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, and operational readiness activities.
* Prepare materials for technical reviews, quarterly business reviews, and customer meetings; document customer needs and communicate product feedback to client teams.
* Recommend Google Cloud practices that improve adoption, reliability, security, and performance; escalate complex technical or customer issues to the Senior Technical Account Manager.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

At Deloitte, AI \& Engineering brings together engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated, sector\-focused solutions across software, data, artificial intelligence, networks, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. Our teams help clients modernize technology and data platforms, improve mission\-critical operations, and create business value through scalable engineering solutions. We tailor our delivery approach to each client's priorities, operating environment, and transformation goals.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree or 12\+ years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, software development, or technical consulting.
* 4\+ years of experience supporting customers with Google Cloud implementations, cloud transformation programs, technical support, customer launches, release management, escalations, or technical consulting.
* 1\+ years of experience designing, developing, supporting, or operating microservices, distributed systems, and application programming interfaces (APIs) using software development practices.
* Must currently hold a Google Cloud Professional certification in at least one of the following: Professional Cloud Architect; Professional Cloud Database Engineer; Professional Cloud Developer; Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer; Professional Cloud Network Engineer; Professional Cloud Security Engineer; Professional Data Engineer; Professional Machine Learning Engineer; or Professional Security Operations Engineer.
* Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  

**Preferred:**  

* Experience supporting public\-sector customers in Google Cloud environments.
* Experience coordinating customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, or operational readiness activities.
* Experience preparing materials for technical reviews or quarterly business reviews.

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,000 to $170,000\.  

  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Analyst, Account Management
Overview  

  

Mastercard's Community Institutions team is launching Team Catalyst, an innovative new account management model designed to redefine how we partner with our longer\-tail customers.  

  

As customer expectations evolve and operational complexity increases, we are transforming from a traditional one\-to\-one account management structure to an agile, team\-based model that enables us to deliver deeper expertise, greater consistency, and broader access to Mastercard's capabilities.  

  

Team Catalyst is an incubation team focused on building the future of customer partnership and engagement. We are challenging conventional approaches, creating scalable strategies, leveraging data and automation, and finding new ways to bring the full power of Mastercard to our customers.  

  

This role offers a unique opportunity to help design, build, and scale a new model while directly influencing customer growth, experience, and operational excellence across a portfolio of Community Institution customers.  

  

If you thrive in fast\-paced environments, enjoy turning ideas into action, and are energized by solving complex problems, we'd love to meet you.  

  

The Role  

  

As an Analyst, Account Management on Team Catalyst, you will manage a portfolio of Community Institution customers and help deliver an exceptional Mastercard experience.  

  

You will build customer relationships, identify opportunities for growth, support business initiatives, and partner across Mastercard to address customer needs. Working within a highly collaborative team environment, you will help customers maximize the value of their Mastercard partnership while contributing to Team Catalyst's innovative account management model.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

  

Manage: Serve as the primary relationship manager for a portfolio of Community Institution customers, building trusted partnerships and supporting customer success.  

  

Grow: Identify opportunities to expand customer engagement and adoption of Mastercard products, services, and solutions.  

  

Advise: Develop an understanding of customer priorities, challenges, and goals to provide relevant recommendations and support.  

  

Execute: Lead day\-to\-day account management activities, including customer communications, action planning, issue resolution, and follow\-up.  

  

Collaborate: Partner with teams across Product, Services, Technology, Operations, Marketing, and Sales to deliver solutions and address customer needs.  

  

Support: Assist with renewals, pricing requests, presentations, business cases, and other commercial activities.  

  

Educate: Deliver customer engagement activities including webinars, office hours, portfolio communications, and customer education programs.  

  

Improve: Contribute ideas and process improvements that enhance customer experience, operational efficiency, and team performance.  

  

All About You  

  

* Relationship builder with a passion for customer success.

  

* Strong communicator who can build credibility with customers and internal stakeholders.

  

* Curious and proactive problem solver.

  

* Organized and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.

  

* Analytical mindset with the ability to turn insights into action.

  

* Collaborative team player who thrives in a fast\-paced environment.

  

* Growth\-oriented with a willingness to learn and take on new challenges.

  

* Adaptable, resourceful, and comfortable navigating change.


Mastercard is a merit\-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Account Manager

Liminal is the intelligence platform for the people who build and buy the technology that keeps the digital economy safe. Our platform delivers AI\-powered solutions that empower customers to assess, interpret, and respond to global market shifts, critical events, and regulatory developments. We are a Series A company of about 60 people.

 **About the role**


Customers want more research, more data, and more time with our experts than we can serve today. Your job is to capture that demand.  

As an Account Manager, you own a book of existing customers and grow it. You run renewals, sell expansions, and ensure every account buys the full range of what Liminal offers: platform, field intelligence feeds, research, and events.  

This is one of a small number of commercial seats we are adding this year. You will report to the VP of Sales.

 **What you'll do**

* Own renewals and expansion for a portfolio of accounts, protecting revenue and growing every relationship year over year
* Sell into existing customers: data subscriptions, field intelligence feeds, research reprints, webinars, and event partnerships
* Follow up on and close inbound platform opportunities quickly and completely
* Grow the number of teams using Liminal inside each account: product, strategy, marketing, and sales
* Coordinate with Customer Success, Delivery, and our practice experts to bring the right people and the right intelligence to each customer
* Spot at\-risk accounts early and act with a clear plan well ahead of renewal
* Keep HubSpot current: pipeline, renewal dates, forecasts, and expansion opportunities
* Turn what works into repeatable plays the commercial team can run

**Qualifications**

* 3\+ years of account management, customer success, or sales experience in B2B SaaS, data, or research
* Renewal and expansion results you can speak to specifically
* Relentless follow\-through: you close every loop and never let an opportunity go cold
* Comfort selling to senior buyers, from analysts to executives, in enterprise accounts
* Comfortability working with the latest AI models, including connectors and MCP services
* Familiarity with at least one of our six markets: fraud prevention, financial crime compliance, trust and safety, cybersecurity, risk management, or payments
* Experience at an early\-stage company where you built process, not just followed it
* Able to work hybrid from our Union Square office

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* $90,000–$115,000 base salary plus commission, for on\-target earnings of $125,000–$150,000, with a performance bonus and equity
* Close work with senior leadership and real ownership of your book

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Open Standard**


Open Standard is on a mission to build the world's best money, starting with the US dollar. We believe money should move the way data does: instantly, globally, at any hour, in any amount. Today, financial transactions are hindered by delays, fees, and inefficiencies that every business must bear. We’re here to change that.


Our flagship product, Open USD, is a stablecoin designed for the internet: programmable, global, and built to reward the businesses that champion its adoption. Launched in close partnership with industry leaders like Stripe, Visa, Mastercard, Coinbase, and Shopify, Open Standard already has over 200 top companies in its network. Our lean team is based in San Francisco and New York and is led by Zach Abrams, who co\-founded Bridge (acquired by Stripe for $1\.1B) and previously led product at Brex, Coinbase, and Square.


Money is the world's most foundational product. Join us to help redefine it.

**Your role**


As Open Standard’s first Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in bringing the world’s largest banks, payment companies, and fintechs onto the Open USD platform. From the day a partner signs, you will become their main point of contact, guiding them through integration, launch, and every stage of future growth. You’ll collaborate closely with product teams at our founding partners, including Stripe, Coinbase, Visa, and Mastercard, whose customers will be among the first to use Open USD.


This is an exciting opportunity to help shape Open Standard’s partner experience, take our earliest partnerships live, and convert a network of signed partners into a community of deeply engaged adopters.

**What you'll do**

* Launch new partners quickly by coordinating across Legal, Product, Compliance, and integration teams, ensuring launches happen in days, not weeks
* Develop tailored growth plans with each partner: define how Open USD fits their business, project transaction volumes for the first year, and identify key success drivers; lead quarterly reviews with partner leadership
* Connect partners within the network to foster collaboration and unlock new value as more companies adopt Open USD
* Serve as the single point of contact for partners after signing: manage launch announcements, handle reporting questions, and involve internal teams (Finance, Legal, Product) as needed
* Own the partner demand picture: build and maintain partner\-level forecasts that guide Liquidity, Finance, and Product planning
* Continuously improve our onboarding and product by turning every partner’s experience into future best practices and enhancements

**You may be a good fit if you**

* Have experience onboarding partners at a payments network, stablecoin issuer, or banking\-as\-a\-service platform
* Have worked in a network or marketplace business where facilitating participant connections was part of your role
* Possess enough technical fluency to lead integration calls without needing a dedicated solutions engineer

**Strong candidates may also have**

* Experience onboarding partners at a payments network, stablecoin issuer, or banking\-as\-a\-service platform (if not already mentioned above)
* Additional technical expertise to independently own integration conversations

**Logistics**

* **Location:** San Francisco or New York, hybrid with a mix of in\-office and remote days

**Come work with us**


Open Standard is headquartered in San Francisco with an office in New York. We’re a small, senior, and entrepreneurial team with high autonomy and trust. If our mission excites you and you meet most of the qualifications, we want to hear from you.


Compensation Range: $175K \- $210K

jobs.description:
### **About Darkroom**

**Darkroom** is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by **Shadow**, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: **billions in attributable revenue** driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the **fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\)** and among the **most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos)**. Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**About the Role**


Darkroom owns creator strategy for the brands we work with, and more of them now want a community behind it: creators, customers, and fans who post because they want to, not because a brief told them to. This role builds those communities from zero and runs them as a growth channel.


A community here is measured on what it produces outside itself: posts, content, referrals, and signups or sales. Most of our communities are tiered. A small inner circle of top creators gets money, early access, and a direct line to the brand. A larger ambassador tier gets access, perks, and first look at launches. Program tiers, like campus leaders or customer champions, run their own threads. And the open community is where everyone else joins. You decide how people get in, what each tier gets, what happens every week, and how activity turns into output.


This is a consumer role. The people in these communities are students, parents, professionals, and fans, and a community run like a support forum or a developer channel will not work here.


You report to a Director and work alongside the creator leads, the social team, paid media, and each client's product and brand teams.


This role is based in New York, working US hours, with travel for events.

**What You'll Do**


Build new communities

* Choose the platform for each community (usually Discord, sometimes Slack, WhatsApp, Geneva, Circle, or a subreddit) and stand it up: channel architecture, roles and permissions, bots, onboarding, tier assignment, and moderation rules.
* Set the entry rules and the offer for each tier with the creator leads and the client, such as free product for creators over a follower threshold, student access, or referral perks.
* Build a proof channel before launch, where members show what the product did for them. It is the flex wall, and the best posts get reposted by the brand.


Run it every week

* Welcome new members, assign tiers, and post open briefs in \#briefs with a clear view of who claimed what and when it is due.
* Run the 1\-in\-20 triage: find the post that popped, work out why, and brief the rest of the roster on it the same week.
* Repost the top receipts and hand the best ones to the social and paid teams.
* Give members a real line to the brand. Route product questions, feedback, and bug reports to the client's team and bring the answers back.
* Monthly: an AMA with someone from the brand, program leaderboards, and a roster health check (who is posting, who has gone quiet, and what you do about it).


Launches and drops

* Every launch lands in the community first. You run the sequence: inner circle, then ambassadors and program tiers, then everyone else, in step with the social team.
* Get real conversation going in the first two hours. No copy\-paste.


In person

* Co\-run creator events with the creator leads, such as pre\-launch dinners, launch parties, and campus or pop\-up activations. Recruit into the community on the spot, and make sure every event produces content.


Measure it

* Report on each community as a growth channel: members by tier, weekly active share, proof posts per week, the share of ambassadors posting, and signups or sales attributed through community links and codes.
* Write the SOPs as you go, so each program scales, transfers, and makes the next build faster.

**What Good Looks Like at 90 Days**

* At least one community is live with tiers, onboarding, and moderation, ahead of a client launch.
* The client's creator roster is in it, and the proof channel has a steady flow of posts from real use.
* The weekly cadence runs through the Creator Associates. You are not the one moderating.
* Community activity is tied to signups or sales in a view the client can read.
* There is a written playbook the next community can start from.

**What We're Looking For**

* You have built and run an online community for a consumer product, ideally one that grew fast. This is the most important thing on this list. Running a Discord at thousands of members is a strong signal. Moderating someone else's community is not the same thing.
* You know what makes people post. You can say why one post gets reshared and another does not, and turn that into a brief other people can use.
* Fluent in creator culture across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and X, and comfortable with everyone from a college sophomore to a creator with a million followers.
* Technical enough to own the setup yourself: roles, permissions, bots, onboarding f

成为全球市场领先的在线餐饮生活平台，赋能海外中餐产业，搭建中餐爱好者与中华美食的桥梁。

Connecting merchants to consumers via our state\-of\-the\-art online platform and industry\-leading delivery service. jobs.description:
**About NYC Health \+ Hospitals**
---------------------------------

  

MetroPlus**Health** provides the highest quality healthcare services to residents of Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens and Staten Island through a comprehensive list of products, including, but not limited to, New York State Medicaid Managed Care, Medicare, Child Health Plus, Exchange, Partnership in Care, MetroPlus Gold, Essential Plan, etc. As a wholly\-owned subsidiary of NYC Health \+ Hospitals, the largest public health system in the United States, MetroPlus**Health**'s network includes over 27,000 primary care providers, specialists and participating clinics. For more than 40 years, MetroPlus**Health** has been committed to building strong relationships with its members and providers.


Purpose of Position:


Under supervision, identifies qualified participants and educates them as to the benefits of selecting MetroPlus as a managed care provider. Achieves predetermined monthly enrollments based on regularly updated goals and objectives. May provide training of and/or supervision to subordinate staff and maintains a positive public relations presence within the community.


**Work Shifts**
---------------

  

**9:00 A.M – 5:00 P.M**  

  

  



**Duties \& Responsibilities**
------------------------------

  

Level I


* Implement methods, activities and action plans necessary to achieve daily, weekly and monthly objectives.


* Presents clear and accurate information regarding health plan to eligible recipients and community\-at\-large.


* Performs group and individual presentations for purpose of educating and enrolling qualified participants in a variety of arenas included but not limited to income support centers, provider sites, churches, WIC programs and shelters.


* Presents MetroPlusHealth Plan information to HHC employees at annually designated open enrollment periods.


* Performs telemarketing activities as appropriate for purposes of enrollment and follow\-up activity.


* Maintains accurate documentation related to enrollment and field activities.


* Participates in regularly scheduled sales/marketing meetings as required.


* Performs other related tasks as directed.


Level II


* May act as a preceptor to subordinate enrollment sales representative assistants or enrollment sales representatives to facilitate their understanding of MetroPlus objectives, operations and site specific information.


* Implements and monitors appropriate methods, activities and action plans necessary to regularly achieve accelerated predetermined enrollment objectives.


* Ensures appropriate and accurate documentation of plan enrollments and field activities.


* Provides assistance and facilities communications to sales management team.


* Participates in bi\-weekly and monthly sales/marketing meetings.


* Performs related duties.


* Performs all duties of enrollment sales representative level I.


**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  

1\. Satisfactory completion of three months of training and orientation administered by MHP personnel; or,
  

2\. High School graduation or evidence of having satisfactorily passed a High School
  

Equivalency Program; and,
  

3\. Demonstrated skills in written and or oral communication; and,
  

4\. Minimum one year of experience in direct consumer contact, sales and/or social services; or,
  

5\. A satisfactory equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
  

6\. Knowledge of a second language may be required.
  

  

Special Notes:
  

1\. For placement in Assignment Level II, candidates must possess one (1\) year of experience in Assignment Level I or an additional year of related full\-time experience.
  

2\. For placement in Assignment Level III, candidates must possess one (1\) year of experience in Assignment Level II or an additional two (2\) years of related full\-time experience, with at least one (1\) of those years in a supervisory capacity.


**Benefits**
------------

  

NYC Health and Hospitals offers a competitive benefits package that includes:


* Comprehensive Health Benefits for employees hired to work 20\+ hrs. per week
* Retirement Savings and Pension Plans
* Paid Holidays and Vacation in accordance with employees' Collectively bargained contracts
* Loan Forgiveness Programs for eligible employees
* College tuition discounts and professional development opportunities
* College Savings Program
* Union Benefits for eligible titles
* Multiple employee discounts programs
* Commuter Benefits Programs

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Middesk:**
------------------


Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.


Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.


Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.


**About Middesk**


Middesk’s mission is to make it easier for businesses to work together through building the best\-in\-class business identity platform. Our APIs allow B2B companies to access the information, insights, and documentation they need to onboard and transact with their customers. Our products help product, risk, and finance teams make informed regulatory compliance and commercial credit decisions, confirm that suppliers meet federal and state licensing requirements, and register their customers with the necessary government agencies.

**The Role**


Middesk is looking for a high\-energy, driven professional with business acumen, technical aptitude and sales instincts to join our competitive Sales organization as a Sales Development Representative (SDR).


As an SDR, your primary responsibility will be to uncover and qualify new opportunities within Middesk’s target market, focusing on the banking, lending, and payments verticals. Since our SDRs serve as the first point of contact for prospects and customers, your success will be measured by efficient prospecting and outbound efforts to break into new accounts, build relationships across all levels of our customer segments, and create opportunities that drive new business.


Your conversations will reflect a deep understanding of your buyer, their business, and what Middesk means to their success. Ideal candidates will be eager to advance their careers by demonstrating tenacious self\-starting qualities every day with a proven track record of grit and resilience.


On the SDR Team, we pride ourselves on setting challenging goals, and having fun achieving them together. The right candidate is someone who thinks outside the box, thrives under pressure, and is hyper\-focused on meeting targets every single month. We value our culture and are looking for optimistic and motivated people to join our team. Are you up for the challenge?

**What You'll Do**


* **Drive lead generation** and cultivate enduring relationships through strategic outreach, leveraging our tech stack and various channels.
* **Strategically target accounts**, creating a personalized outbound approach for key prospects and decision\-makers.
* **Identify prospective customer’s needs** and present Middesk’s products and services as solutions, drawing on extensive knowledge and research to explain how our offerings meet their needs.
* **Become a product expert** who is knowledgeable about customer’s needs and can easily convey how our solutions uniquely address their most pressing challenges.
* **Develop detailed plans** to achieve predetermined goals and quotas on a quarterly basis.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* **Proven experience of at least 6 mo\-1 year in SaaS Sales Development or similar role.** We’re looking for a highly motivated and target driven with a proven track record of success in sales.
* **Comfortable cold calling, prospecting, and conducting thorough outreach** using tools like Salesforce, Salesloft, LeadIQ, and/or LinkedIn Sales Navigator. A proven track record of achieving sales metrics and consistent achievement of quota attainment makes for an ideal candidate.
* **Excellent written and verbal communication skills.** Your primary charter is to talk to our prospects. Whatever form of communication that requires, you must represent yourself, the team, Middesk, and our customers well. Clear, concise, actionable communication is imperative.
* **The ability to work in a fast paced, team environment.** Ideal candidates will have demonstrated the ability to problem solve autonomously, manage your time well, and remain organized. When faced with challenges, you’ll take initiative to resolve them and deliver your best work.
* **Motivation, drive and a positive self\-starting attitude.** You will meet these criteria by showing a strong desire to pursue a career in Sales and willingness to achieve results. We’re looking for the curiosity and perseverance to push harder when the going gets tough. This is a fast\-paced, high pressure role where change is constant – optimism is a must.
* **Growth mindset and a desire to win.** You’ll demonstrate a commitment to learning and continuous development and show this through proactive reflection and the ability to receive, digest, and action constructive feedback. The best SDRs are those who continue to learn and get better every day.
* **Be a team player** by working collaboratively to share information, foster teamwork, and contribute to a positive work environment. You act with integrity and intent, hold yourself accountable for your actions, and behave according to our company values.
* **Someone based in the NYC area and excited to be working in the office**. Middesk is a hybrid company and as an SDR you would be expected to be in\-office 4\-5 days per week.

**Nice to Haves:**

* Experience in financial services or FinTech
* Experience in fast\-paced, startup environment
* Bachelor’s degree


Compensation Range: $75K \- $90K

We’re Hyve \- organiser of the world’s fastest\-growing and most forward\-thinking B2B events. **School of Nursing \- Clinical Operations Associate Description**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive Clinical Operations Associate to manage student data and oversee compliance with clinical health requirements for our graduate nursing program. This role is vital in ensuring that all students meet the necessary health and regulatory standards to participate in clinical placements. The ideal candidate will possess strong communication skills, expertise in compliance management, and a commitment to supporting student success.

**Responsibilities:**

* Oversight of Records: Responsible for the comprehensive management of student records related to clinical health requirements, including immunizations, background checks, and certifications. Ensure all documentation is complete, accurate, and up to date.
* Data Tracking: Utilize data management systems to track student compliance status and generate reports for program leadership. Identify trends and potential areas for improvement based on compliance data.
* One\-on\-One Guidance: Work closely with individual students to address compliance\-related questions and concerns. Provide personalized support to help students understand and fulfill their clinical health requirements.
* Education on Requirements: Develop and deliver informative sessions or materials to educate students on the necessary compliance standards and procedures, ensuring they are well\-informed about their responsibilities.
* Conduct Audits: Regularly perform compliance audits of student records to verify adherence to institutional policies and regulatory standards. Ensure that the program maintains a compliance rate of 90% or higher.
* Follow\-Up Actions: Identify any compliance deficiencies during audits and implement follow\-up actions to rectify issues. Collaborate with students and faculty to ensure timely resolution of any non\-compliance.
* CastleBranch Management: Serve as the primary resource for CastleBranch, utilizing this platform to manage student health compliance data effectively. Maintain expert\-level knowledge of the system to assist students and faculty in navigating compliance requirements.
* System Optimization: Continuously seek opportunities to optimize the use of CastleBranch for data management and reporting. Stay updated on system enhancements and features to improve compliance tracking processes.
* Interdepartmental Collaboration: Work closely with faculty, clinical coordinators, and administrative staff to ensure alignment on compliance requirements and to address any challenges that may arise. Foster a collaborative environment focused on student success.
* Reporting: Prepare and present compliance reports to program leadership, highlighting trends, challenges, and areas for improvement. Use data\-driven insights to inform strategic decision\-making regarding compliance initiatives.
* Process Evaluation: Participate in ongoing evaluation of compliance processes and procedures to identify opportunities for improvement. Recommend and implement best practices to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in managing student compliance.
* Feedback Mechanism: Establish a feedback loop with students and faculty to gather insights on compliance processes. Use this information to refine procedures and ensure they meet the needs of all stakeholders.


Requirements:
**Experience**

* Healthcare experience
* Proven experience in compliance management, student records administration, or a related role in healthcare or education.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a focus on building supportive relationships.

You'll be one of the primary people our customers interact with, both in person and remotely.

**Job Summary**

Diane Endeavors is looking for a confident, energetic, and highly motivated **Client Experience \& Marketing Specialist** to join our growing team.

This is a fast\-paced, customer\-facing role for someone who likes to **take ownership, make decisions, solve problems, and get things done**.

Our clients come to us because they need marketing materials, printing, direct mail, signage, and creative solutions—but they don't always know exactly what they need. Your job is to take the lead.

You'll talk with clients, understand what they're trying to accomplish, recommend the right products and solutions, coordinate their projects, and keep orders moving from idea to completion.

Graphic design skills are required, but **this is not primarily a graphic design position**. You should be comfortable working in Adobe Creative Suite and making professional designs, edits, and layouts quickly. However, the larger focus of this position is working with customers, managing projects, recommending solutions, generating sales, and making sure things get finished.

**Bilingual English/Spanish candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.**

**About the Role**

This position is equal parts:

* Graphic Designer
* Customer Service Representative
* Marketing Consultant
* Project Coordinator
* Print Production Associate

A typical day might include:

* Recommending additional products that would make a client's marketing campaign more effective
* Creating or editing a postcard while the customer sits beside you
* Responding to several incoming emails, calls, and customer requests
* Following up on open projects and keeping customers moving toward a decision

* Preparing files for production, printing projects and finishing them on the print production equipment.

We're not looking for someone who uses aggressive sales tactics. We're looking for someone who is comfortable taking the lead in a conversation, making recommendations, and asking for the business.

You'll be expected to:

* Learn our products and services so you can confidently recommend them
* Listen to customer needs

* Create a sales experience that builds long\-term relationships and repeat business

* Learn and use our order management and invoicing systems

**No previous print production experience is required.** We'll teach you our equipment, processes, products, and production workflow.

**Qualifications Required**

* Experience with Adobe Illustrator
* Experience with Adobe InDesign
* Experience with Adobe Photoshop
* Experience with Canva
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Confidence speaking directly with customers
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
* Strong organization and follow\-through
* Ability to work quickly without sacrificing accuracy
* Comfortable making decisions and solving problems independently
* Willingness to learn new products, systems, and processes

**A Huge Plus**

* **Bilingual in English and Spanish**
* Previous sales experience
* Previous customer service or account management experience
* Experience working with small\-business owners or Realtors
* Experience in marketing, advertising, printing, or direct mail
* Experience managing projects with short turnaround times

* Enjoy talking with customers and building relationships

* Like learning how a business works instead of staying inside one narrowly defined role

jobs.title: GCP Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III), you will support Public Sector customers with cloud adoption, operational planning, technical issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination. Working alongside senior team members, you will help maintain account health and coordinate activities across customer and delivery partner teams. You will contribute to reliable, secure cloud outcomes in complex public\-sector environments. This remote role is available to candidates who can work from within the continental United States.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/21/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III) on the AI \& Engineering team, you will be responsible for:
  

* Coordinate technical activities across assigned customer workstreams and track customer issues, risks, dependencies, action items, and upcoming milestones.
* Collaborate with client Support, Product Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and customer escalations.
* Support customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, and operational readiness activities.
* Prepare materials for technical reviews, quarterly business reviews, and customer meetings; document customer needs and communicate product feedback to client teams.
* Recommend Google Cloud practices that improve adoption, reliability, security, and performance; escalate complex technical or customer issues to the Senior Technical Account Manager.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

At Deloitte, AI \& Engineering brings together engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated, sector\-focused solutions across software, data, artificial intelligence, networks, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. Our teams help clients modernize technology and data platforms, improve mission\-critical operations, and create business value through scalable engineering solutions. We tailor our delivery approach to each client's priorities, operating environment, and transformation goals.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree or 12\+ years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, software development, or technical consulting.
* 4\+ years of experience supporting customers with Google Cloud implementations, cloud transformation programs, technical support, customer launches, release management, escalations, or technical consulting.
* 1\+ years of experience designing, developing, supporting, or operating microservices, distributed systems, and application programming interfaces (APIs) using software development practices.
* Must currently hold a Google Cloud Professional certification in at least one of the following: Professional Cloud Architect; Professional Cloud Database Engineer; Professional Cloud Developer; Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer; Professional Cloud Network Engineer; Professional Cloud Security Engineer; Professional Data Engineer; Professional Machine Learning Engineer; or Professional Security Operations Engineer.
* Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  

**Preferred:**  

* Experience supporting public\-sector customers in Google Cloud environments.
* Experience coordinating customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, or operational readiness activities.
* Experience preparing materials for technical reviews or quarterly business reviews.

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,000 to $170,000\.  

  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
