Richelieu is a leading North American distributor, importer, and manufacturer of specialty hardware and complementary products. Our products are targeted to an extensive customer base of kitchen and bathroom cabinet, storage and closet, home furnishing and office furniture manufacturers, door and window, residential and commercial woodworkers, and hardware retailers including renovation superstores. Richelieu offers customers a broad mix of high\-end products sourced from manufacturers worldwide. With over 150,000 product offerings, 112 locations in North America, and a state\-of\-the\-art field force that passionately serves over 110,000 customers, Richelieu continues to stand in the forefront of a dynamic and ever\-changing industry.



Since 1968, Richelieu has understood the significance and impact of a strong set of Core Values. Richelieu stands behind these **Five Core Values** that serve as the guiding principles of everything we do: *Customer Focus, Innovation, Performance, Respect/Integrity/Ethics, and Ownership.*



These values are what allow us to achieve **Our Mission:** *to enable our customers to profitably grow their businesses through the design and creation of exceptional kitchens, closets, and storage spaces.*


**Our Opportunity**  

  

We are currently seeking a **Wood Coatings / Finishing Sales Specialist** to take responsibility for growing our local sales region is Georgia .


**Must live in local sales territory.**



Being a member of the Richelieu team means that you are part of something bigger than just yourself. As a growing and winning international organization that places emphasis on its people and culture, its career development opportunities, and the realization that healthy living is in part achieved by the proper balance of work and home, we are excited to be a company that our employees are passionate about!


**Key Responsibilities**



The **Wood Coatings / Finishing Sales Specialist** is a **technical sales** position responsible for the overall relationship and management of day\-to\-day sales activities towards cabinet and furniture manufacturer accounts in his/her territory. You will successfully manage the sales of **Richelieu’s Finishing product solutions (**Coatings, Sundries, Abraisives and Paint equipment.) through structured consultative sales discussions, ultimately serving as a business advisor towards your customers. By positioning yourself as an indispensable resource, you will enable your customers to solve problems and increase business results. In turn, you will be building a thriving business of your own.


* Work in tandem with Richelieu's Industrial Sales Representatives to schedule and hold face\-to\-face consultations with new and existing customers, learning about their business and how Richelieu Finishing product solutions can enhance their results
* Maintain accountability for the growth of your provided territory, both through the development of existing relationships as well as the acquisition of new customers
* Identify and analyze past buying patterns of current accounts, and brainstorm ways to become their stronger, more inclusive supplier
* Provide a state of the art customer service experience, positioning yourself as their desired one\-stop shop
* Educate yourself on, and continuously stay up to date with, Richelieu’s Finishing product offerings, as well as ever\-changing market conditions and competitive analysis
* Hold responsibility for system information and reporting in CRM application
* As this position requires regular automobile travel, you must have your own independent, reliable transportation. This position requires you to work "in the field," making in\-person visits to customers three to four days per week
* This position may involve lifting/pushing/carrying items up to 50 pounds, working around fumes, airborne particles, or toxic chemicals

  


**What We Are Looking For**


* Technically\-minded, preferably with a **background or experience in chemistry or science, and/or spray coatings**
* University degree – preferred in chemistry /science
* Spray application finish background is a plus
* Must have an understanding of (or ability to quickly gain expertise in) coatings and finishing with various products, applications, and methods
* Passionate, proactive, coachable, strong work ethic
* Ability to schedule and manage your own time, delivering on the activities that produce results
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills

* Strong communicator and natural relationship builder, able to consult with customers, understand their needs, and guide them to the right solution.

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Mileage reimbursement
* Short\- and long\-term disability, life insurance, and well\-being programs
* Paid time off
* Culture of professional development and career growth opportunities
* Flexible work schedule to accommodate you and your customers’ needs
* Click here to view our full benefit offerings

**Why you’ll love working here:**


* We **boldly shape the future**, embracing change, taking smart risks, and continuously improving to create the best experiences.

* We **elevate to serve a greater purpose**, going above and beyond to earn trust, celebrate wins, and value every perspective.

jobs.title: Sanitation & Food Safety Program Specialist, US
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced and highly technical Sanitation \& Food Safety Program Specialist, US to join our growing team!
  
This corporate\-level role is responsible for advancing and standardizing sanitation programs across DO \& CO’s U.S. operations. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on food safety professional who can assess complex production environments, identify sanitation and microbiological risks, lead root\-cause investigations, and translate technical requirements into practical, sustainable solutions.
  
  

About DO \& CO
  
  

We have a passion for hospitality culinary delights on every elevated floor and in the sky. With our three business segments, Airline Catering, International Event Catering, Restaurants, Lounges \& Hotels, we offer gourmet entertainment all over the world. We operate in 33 locations, 12 countries and 3 Continents, maintaining the highest standard of quality in both our products and services. We refine the classics, develop the unknown and grow constantly – sometimes beyond our own expectations.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Provide technical oversight and guidance for sanitation programs across DO \& CO’s U.S. facilities.
* Develop, standardize, and continuously improve SSOPs, Master Sanitation Schedules, cleaning procedures, and verification standards.
* Conduct sanitation assessments across production areas, ready\-to\-eat environments, equipment, coolers, freezers, dishrooms, drains, docks, and waste areas.
* Evaluate cleaning methods, chemicals, concentrations, contact times, equipment, sanitation contractors, and service providers.
* Identify hygienic\-design concerns and sanitation vulnerabilities and partner with facility teams to implement sustainable solutions.
* Establish standardized pre\-operational inspection and release programs across facilities.
* Conduct independent inspections to verify sanitation effectiveness and production readiness.
* Identify food residue, grease, biofilm risks, standing water, damaged surfaces, inaccessible areas, and other sanitation deficiencies
* Ensure corrective actions are completed and effective before equipment or production areas are released for use.
* Maintain consistent documentation, escalation, and follow\-up procedures for significant findings.
* Support the development and continuous improvement of Environmental Monitoring Programs, with particular focus on ready\-to\-eat and high\-risk areas.
* Review sampling plans, locations, frequencies, zoning, ATP results, and environmental trend data.
* Lead or support investigations involving recurring environmental findings or pathogens, including Listeria species and Listeria monocytogenes.
* Verify intensified cleaning, resampling, mitigation activities, allergen\-cleaning validation, and corrective actions.
* Ensure sanitation tools are properly segregated, dedicated, and color\-coded where required.
* Verify the proper selection, concentration, labeling, storage, dispensing, and use of sanitation chemicals.
* Ensure cleaning practices follow manufacturer instructions and established sanitation procedures.
* Evaluate equipment and facilities for harborage points, damaged surfaces, standing water, condensation, deteriorated seals, and other contamination risks.
* Participate in sanitation reviews for new equipment, renovations, construction projects, and process changes.
* Partner with Maintenance, Engineering, Operations, FSQA, chemical suppliers, and facility leadership to resolve sanitation\-related deficiencies.
* Review pest\-control programs, activity trends, and corrective actions with FSQA and facility leadership.
* Assess waste\-handling areas, docks, compactors, recycling areas, and exterior conditions for sanitation and pest risks.
* Verify sanitation procedures supporting Halal segregation and shared\-equipment controls.
* Evaluate cleaning and tool\-control practices designed to prevent allergen and Halal/non\-Halal cross\-contact.
* Lead sanitation\-related investigations and root\-cause analyses.
* Develop risk\-based corrective and preventive action recommendations.
* Verify the completion and sustained effectiveness of sanitation CAPAs.
* Identify recurring findings across facilities and recommend long\-term, systemic solutions.
* Escalate significant sanitation and food safety risks to FSQA leadership.
* Develop and deliver technical training on SSOPs, GMPs, chemical safety, sanitation verification, environmental pathogen controls, and cross\-contamination prevention.
* Coach Sanitation Managers, supervisors, FSQA personnel, Operations teams, and frontline employees.
* Verify training effectiveness through field observations and follow\-up assessments.
* Support FDA inspections, customer audits, third\-party audits, and internal food safety assessments.
* Assist facilities with regulatory observations, customer findings, CAPAs, and effectiveness verification.
* Promote sanitation as a critical food safety preventive control and shared organizational responsibility.


Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Food Safety, Biology, Environmental Health, Public Health, Food Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* At least five years of progressive experience in food manufacturing, airline catering, commissary operations, sanitation, food safety, or quality assurance.
* Strong working knowledge of food sanitation, GMPs, HACCP, Environmental Monitoring Programs, sanitation verification, and preventive controls.
* Demonstrated experience conducting sanitation inspections, investigations, root\-cause analyses, and corrective\-action follow\-up.
* Experience identifying microbiological, sanitation, hygienic\-design, allergen, and cross\-contamination risks in complex food\-production environments.
* Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

**Role Summary**


The Executive Assistant and Workplace Coordinator provides high\-quality executive, administrative, office operations, and project support to the Chief Financial Officer and Finance team. This role serves as a trusted partner to the CFO, managing calendars, travel, meetings, communications, expenses, confidential materials, and follow\-through on priorities. The role also oversees day\-to\-day Lake Forest office operations and provides light project management, financial systems, and accounting support to help the Finance function operate efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Executive \&*** ***Finance*** ***Team Support***

* Serve as the primary administrative point of contact for the CFO, exercising sound judgment, discretion, and urgency in managing requests, priorities, and follow\-up.
* Provide calendar management for the CFO and support scheduling across the Finance leadership team, including prioritizing inquiries, resolving conflicts, and anticipating preparation needs.
* Coordinate domestic and occasional international travel; prepare itineraries, manage changes, and ensure timely submission of expense reports in accordance with company policy.
* Draft, proofread, format, and organize executive correspondence, presentations, board and committee materials, meeting agendas, and Finance team communications.
* Coordinate onsite, virtual, and offsite meetings, including logistics, materials, catering, A/V, guest access, and follow\-up action items.

***Office Operations***

* Serve as the primary Lake Forest office point of contact with building management, facilities, security, IT, maintenance providers, and other vendors.
* Oversee office supply, kitchen, coffee, mail, and conference room needs; coordinate repairs, service requests, visitor access, and lunch and meeting room readiness.
* Manage the visitor and employee office experience, including reception coverage, badges, office communications, and day\-to\-day troubleshooting.
* Support office\-related events, team meetings, executive visits, and cross\-functional gatherings with a high level of customer service and follow\-through.
***Project Management, Systems \& Light Accounting Support***

* Support strategic\- and Finance\-related projects by tracking timelines, deliverables, meeting notes, owners, and follow\-up items to ensure progress and accountability.
* Assist with coordination of Finance processes and recurring activities, including audit requests, budget meetings, procurement workflows, and departmental communications.
* Provide light system support, including maintaining distribution lists, access request tracking, SharePoint/OneDrive organization, workflow status logs, running reports, and basic user coordination with IT or system owners.
* Provide accounting and administrative support, such as invoice routing, coding support, purchase order follow\-up, vendor setup coordination, expense documentation, and reconciliation assistance under Finance guidance.
***Records \& Systems***

* Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems for Finance and office records, including appropriate naming conventions, version control, and retention practices.
* Support maintenance of confidential Finance, executive, vendor, contract, audit, tax, insurance, and administrative records in accordance with company policies.
***Additional Responsibilities***

* Identify opportunities to streamline administrative workflows, improve Finance team coordination, enhance office efficiency, and strengthen records organization.
* Act like an owner with a sense of urgency, escalating issues appropriately and following through until completion.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, deadlines, and stakeholders in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, professional presence, sound judgment, and strong customer\-service orientation.

* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, and comfort learning company systems and workflows.
* Experience supporting a CFO, Finance, Accounting, Investor Relations, Legal, or other corporate executive function.
* Project coordination experience, including tracking action items, timelines, deliverables, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Familiarity with basic accounting administration, invoice processing, purchase orders, expense reporting, vendor coordination, or ERP/workflow systems.
* Experience supporting facilities, vendors, office operations, and onsite executive or team events.
**Core Competencies**

* Executive Presence \& Judgment — represents the CFO and Finance team professionally and handles sensitive matters with discretion.
* Organization \& Prioritization — anticipates needs, manages competing deadlines, and keeps priorities moving.
* Communication Excellence — prepares clear, concise, accurate, and audience\-appropriate communications and materials.
* Service Orientation — builds trust with executives, employees, visitors, vendors, and external partners through responsive, high\-quality support.
* Ownership \& Initiative — identifies gaps, proposes solutions, manages details, and follows through to completion.

jobs.description:
Part\-Time \| Chicago, IL \| 9–18 Hours/Week

About Framed

Framed Eyewear is an independent optical business focused on providing a highly personalized, luxury patient experience. We are a small, growing company that values craftsmanship, professionalism, education, and genuine relationships over the traditional high\-volume retail environment.

We're looking for a Patient Experience \& Outreach Coordinator to become an important part of our growing Chicago team.

This is a people\-focused position for someone who enjoys making people feel welcome, building relationships, creating opportunities, and representing a business they genuinely believe in.

The role combines patient experience, appointment generation, community outreach, light styling, and day\-to\-day showroom support.

We're open to candidates from a variety of backgrounds, including opticians, optical technicians, retail professionals, hospitality professionals, and people with strong customer\-service and relationship\-building experience.

What You'll Do

Patient Experience

Patient experience comes first whenever a patient or visitor is in the showroom.

* Welcome every patient and visitor in a warm, professional, and genuine manner
* Serve as the first point of contact for walk\-ins, phone calls, messages, and inquiries
* Help create a polished, elevated, and personalized showroom experience
* Assist with light frame styling when appropriate
* Anticipate patient needs and look for opportunities to make their experience easier, more comfortable, and more personalized

Scheduling \& Patient Follow\-Up

* Schedule appointments for new and prospective patients
* Respond promptly and professionally to phone calls, messages, and other patient inquiries
* Follow up with prospective patients who have expressed interest but have not yet scheduled
* Confirm upcoming appointments and assist with rescheduling when needed
* Track inquiries and follow\-up so that prospective patients don't fall through the cracks
* Follow up with patients as appropriate before and after appointments

Community Outreach \& Business Development

* Identify businesses and organizations that may be a natural fit for Framed's patient base
* Initiate conversations with prospective community partners and look for mutually beneficial opportunities and follow up
* Identify opportunities to generate new patients through local outreach and relationship\-building
* Participate in local events and community activities when appropriate

Showroom \& Administrative Support

* Keep the showroom clean, organized, polished, and presentation\-ready throughout the day
* Restock basic supplies and showroom materials as needed
* Receive, organize, and put away deliveries when needed

Who We’re Looking For

Optical experience is welcome but not required. Opticians and optical technicians, particularly those earlier in their careers, are encouraged to apply.

* Naturally personable and comfortable talking with people they don't know
* Understands and embraces the expectations of a luxury, high\-touch environment
* Polished, professional, warm, and dependable
* Attentive to detail and understands that small details can make a significant difference
* Confident approaching local businesses and starting conversations
* Comfortable working independently
* Curious and eager to learn
* Good at reading people and understanding what they need
* Interested in eyewear, fashion, design, hospitality, or exceptional customer experience
* Comfortable with sales and asking for the appointment, but never pushy
* Someone who wants to be part of building something rather than simply clocking in and out

Our Philosophy

At Framed, we believe luxury is about the experience, not simply the product.

We don't believe in pressure, gimmicks, or treating people like transactions. The best business growth comes from earning people's trust, not pressuring them into a purchase.

Our goal is for every person who walks through our door to feel that their time, their needs, and their experience genuinely matter.

A Career, Not Just a Job

We believe there should be no ceiling on what you can become at Framed.

As Framed grows, this role may expand in hours and responsibility, with opportunities to develop additional optical, patient\-experience, business\-development, and leadership skills. For the right candidate, this part\-time position has the potential to develop into a full\-time salaried position with significantly greater responsibility and earning potential.

Schedule \& Compensation

* Part\-time: 9–18 hours per week
* Guaranteed schedule: 9 hours/week \- Tuesday \& Thursday, 1:30–6:00 PM
* Additional hours: Up to 9 additional hours/week \- Monday \& Friday, 1:30–6:00 PM, based on availability and business needs.
* Occasional additional fill\-in opportunities may be available as the business grows and other team members schedules require
* Starting pay: $18/hour
* Additional performance\-based compensation
* Paid leave and sick leave provided in accordance with applicable law
* Opportunities for increased hours, responsibility, and compensation as the company grows

The Account Manager will support multiple client relationships or projects. This individual will learn and operate Merkle processes, support account operations, and partner with senior account leadership when client needs, escalations, or business decisions require additional guidance.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Build strong working relationships with internal teams, client contacts, and account leadership.

* Engage with clients by providing updates, capturing needs, and escalating questions or concerns when appropriate.

* Build trust through reliable execution, responsiveness, and attention to detail.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Client\-service mindset with the ability to build relationships and respond professionally to client and internal needs.
* Ability to identify issues, ask thoughtful questions, and escalate complex or sensitive issues appropriately to leadership.
* Self\-motivated, collaborative, solution\-oriented, highly ethical, and eager to learn.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment and adapting to change.
* Developing presentation, storytelling, and insight delivery skills.

The annual salary range for this position is $72,000 \- $85,000\. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.

* Experience preparing materials for technical reviews or quarterly business reviews.

jobs.title: Retail Media Data Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us:**



Pacvue is the leading software suite for eCommerce advertising, sales, and intelligence. We help some of the world's largest brands grow their business on Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, and other marketplaces and work with sellers and agencies of all sizes to help them compete in the constantly changing world of online retail. Our mission is to empower teams to win in the future of eCommerce, and we do it by building first\-to\-market technology, solving complex problems with our customers, and bringing expertise, collaboration, and innovation to our work every single day.


**Why work at Pacvue?**


* Be on the cutting edge \- Pacvue is transforming the way brands and sellers win online. Our product uses machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data to make intelligent decisions and recommendations.
* Have fun – we have an energetic and passionate team with a joint mission to win and help our brands and sellers succeed.
* Learn – from the best! Our team is full of talented people who want to help you learn, grow – providing you with mentorship, the industry's best practices and thought leadership.
* Grow fast – the eCommerce industry has grown fast in the past 2\-3 years. Pacvue has grown even faster than most high\-tech companies in the market.


**About the role:**



We are looking for a self\-starter with a proven track record of working with minimal direction to deliver actionable insights for clients. The ideal candidate will work seamlessly with Pacvue account teams to relate client's business needs to data solutions and create from\-scratch reporting and presentations. This includes activities such as querying databases from multiple platforms, designing dashboards to handoff to client or account teams for self\-service data visualization, presenting findings and solutions to client leadership directly, and working with product managers to incorporate new features into the Pacvue technology.



This position requires a candidate who intimately understands retail media data sets and can use them to answer business questions and to directly provide media insights and recommendations.


**Responsibilities:**


* Meet with clients and account teams to identify business needs, facilitate refinement of business questions, and design reporting deliverables
* Provide direction to clients and account teams on requirements, timing and a deliverable format that will meet their needs, staying in constant communication with stakeholders to keep them updated on progress
* Make use of Pacvue reporting and analysis tools to their fullest extent in addressing business needs, and use good judgement in determining when custom analysis will be required
* Perform custom analysis primarily in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, making use of pivot tables, graphs, advanced formulas, or any other techniques for data visualization or automation
* Set up custom reports to run automatically or with minimal touch from account owners to aid in future independent business reviews
* Lead exploration of emerging retail media databases and capabilities, with particular focus on Amazon Marketing Cloud, but also including Amazon ad console, vendor \& seller central, Target and Walmart advertising \& commerce, as well as Instacart, Criteo, etc.
* Translate analysis into campaign and business recommendations, sharing initial findings of analysis with account teams informally, and assist in presenting final recommendations to client over email and in meetings
* Assist in documentation of methodology for new analysis to help scale across the organization
* Create proposals for product and development teams on where new features should be built based on custom analysis use cases


**Skills \& Qualifications:**


* 2\+ years experience working in eCommerce account management, sales, and/or digital marketing
* 2\+ years experience working in a data and analytics\-focused role
* Previous account management, product management, project management, financial analysis, and/or marketing experience is a plus
* Demonstrate an understanding of how retail media, sales, and operations work together
* Demonstrate an in\-depth understanding of available Amazon data sets, and at least a surface level understanding for additional retail media platforms such as Walmart, Target, or Instacart
* Proven track record of relationship building and working across multiple teams internally
* Proven success in driving results and implementing ideas in a fast\-paced environment
* Works efficiently and is always looking to streamline processes and workflows
* Excellent organizational, communication, and presentation skills
* Strong analytical skills, and the ability to take large data sets and extract actionable recommendations, are a must
* Advanced Excel skills are a must
* Working knowledge of at least one supplemental program such as Tableau or Python is a plus
* Experience with SQL is strongly preferred, specifically in relation to AMC


**Benefits:**


* Unlimited Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays and Floating Holidays
* Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA/HSA, Life Insurance and Pet Insurance
* 401k with Employer Match
* Take up to 2 Days of Paid Time Off to Volunteer with a 501c Organization
* Paid Parental Leave


\#LI\-Remote

 *Pacvue is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.*

Pacvue is the leading Commerce Media OS, powering over $12B in advertising spend across 100\+ global retail media networks including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Instacart, Criteo, and CitrusAd. jobs.description:
### **Client Management**



Chicago \- N. State
#### **About the job**


Merkle is a leading data\-driven, technology\-enabled global performance marketing agency specializing in personalized customer experiences across platforms and devices. For more than 30 years, Fortune 1000 companies and leading nonprofit organizations have partnered with Merkle to maximize the value of their customer portfolios.

  

  

We are looking for an Account Manager to support client success through strong day\-to\-day coordination, operational execution, and internal and external communication. This role supports client account teams across industries by helping ensure work is moving forward, client needs are understood, and internal teams are aligned.

  

  

The Account Manager will support multiple client relationships or projects. This individual will learn and operate Merkle processes, support account operations, and partner with senior account leadership when client needs, escalations, or business decisions require additional guidance.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**


* Support day\-to\-day account operations, including client communications, meeting coordination, follow\-ups, and internal team alignment.
* Learn, follow, and apply Merkle operational processes, including Salesforce account reviews, account maps, account health updates, and forecast support.
* Help manage assigned tasks, deadlines, and account updates with strong organization, attention to detail, and follow\-through.
* Identify potential issues, risks, or client concerns and escalate appropriately to account leadership, project leads, or cross\-functional partners.
* Partner with Project Managers, Project Leads, and delivery teams to understand timelines, deliverables, change requests, proposals, and open items.
* Support revenue forecasting, opportunity updates, operational reporting, and business review preparation.
* Communicate clearly and timely with internal teams and clients regarding project progress, next steps, and decisions needed.
* Contribute to positive client experiences by anticipating needs, tracking action items, and helping ensure timely follow\-through.
  

  

**People \& Teams**


* Build strong working relationships with internal teams, client contacts, and account leadership.
* Support an organized, collaborative, and energized internal account team environment.
* Engage with clients by providing updates, capturing needs, and escalating questions or concerns when appropriate.
* Contribute positively to team culture, morale, and day\-to\-day collaboration.
* Build trust through reliable execution, responsiveness, and attention to detail.
* Continue building technical skills, business acumen, and account management capability through training, coaching, and hands\-on experience.
  

  

**Business Operations \& Account Support**


* Develop a working understanding of revenue recognition, billing, invoicing, forecasting, and financial processes.
* Support invoice tracking, payment follow\-ups, financial reporting, and account health needs in partnership with Finance and account leadership.
* Help review time allocations, project financials, and report outputs to identify questions, risks, or follow\-ups.
* Listen to client needs and share potential risks, opportunities, or growth areas with account leadership.
* Support SOW renewals, change orders, and proposal development by coordinating inputs, timelines, and internal reviews.
* Assist with research, account planning, market intelligence, and materials that support client growth or account planning.
  

  

**Key Skills \& Experience**


* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 3–5 years of experience in client services, account management, project coordination, agency, or relevant client\-side work.
* Experience working with cross\-functional and/or remote teams.
* Foundational project management skills with strong organization, follow\-through, and attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Client\-service mindset with the ability to build relationships and respond professionally to client and internal needs.
* Ability to identify issues, ask thoughtful questions, and escalate complex or sensitive issues appropriately to leadership.
* Self\-motivated, collaborative, solution\-oriented, highly ethical, and eager to learn.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment and adapting to change.
* Developing presentation, storytelling, and insight delivery skills.
  

  

Additional Information:


The annual salary range for this position is $72,000 \- $85,000\. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.

  

  

Benefits available with this position include:


* Medical, vision, and dental insurance,
* Life insurance,
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance,
* 401k,
* Flexible paid time off,
* At least 15 paid holidays per year,
* Paid sick and safe leave, and
* Paid parental leave.

Energy CX is redefining the energy brokerage industry as the fastest\-growing player in the US. By bringing cutting\-edge technology, advanced analytics, and innovative solutions, we are disrupting a space that has operated in the dark for too long.

* Recession proof industry

* Identify and mitigate risk within your book of business

* Act as your customers "In\-house\-expert", answering questions directly or connecting them to the people that can

* 3\+ years of professional experience as an Account Manager or Account Executive (salary depends on experience)
* Proven track record of success \& experience in the stated "Objectives of this Role"

* Hyper\-communication: Timely, clear, and efficient communication externally and internally
* Knowledge of general best practices in sales cycle and/or customer retention

MDL specializes and performs Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) with a larger menu of testing available in the field of infectious disease. Our main theme of research is in the field of Gynecology, Infectious Diseases, Infectious Arthritis, Tick\-borne Diseases, Mycology, and Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS).
  
  

MDL is looking to expand its sales force throughout the U.S. We are seeking a high\-energy, self\-motivated individual to join our sales team. As an Entry Level Account Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining a large client base of existing customers for MDL and serve as a liaison between management and customers to resolve any customer issues.

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious mission: to **inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.**


More than 1/3 of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet. 10% of greenhouse gas emissions come from food waste and loss.


Through our marketplace app, we connect businesses that have unsold, surplus food, with consumers who can buy and enjoy it at a discount of the retail value. We are a certified B Corporation with a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste. Alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.


We’re looking for an exceptional **Enterprise Customer Success Manager** to join the team at Too Good To Go to lead the US partnerships.


**Your role**


As a **Enterprise Customer Success Manager**, you will play a pivotal role in driving the success of our most strategic partnerships. You will be responsible for managing a portfolio of key account partners, building and sustaining strong relationships with senior stakeholders. With a proactive, consultative, and data\-driven approach, you will identify opportunities to increase meals saved, grow account value, and expand product adoption. By deeply understanding each partner’s business challenges, you will deliver tailored solutions aligned with our value drivers, ensuring long\-term mutual success.


In this role, you will oversee the full account lifecycle from onboarding through to ongoing optimization. You will lead the development and execution of strategic account plans, conduct regular performance reviews such as Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and focus on driving retention at both HQ and store levels. Your ability to effectively pitch our full product portfolio will be key to introducing new categories and enhancing partner engagement. Collaborating closely with Sales, Store Operations, and Marketing teams, you will ensure strong store coverage, optimize supply quality, and deliver a seamless partner experience, all in support of our mission to reduce food waste.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Drive Account Growth**: Own the health and success of your customers from launch through expansion, with a focus on optimizing meals saved.
* **Analyze and Manage Risks**: Analyze store data to forecast meal savings accurately. Identify, communicate, and manage store risks proactively throughout the year, and lead in developing resolution strategies.
* **Provide Consultative Support:** Offer expert recommendations on food\-saving practices
* **Lead Client Meetings:** Regularly lead and present at client meetings, both in\-person and via video conference, to ensure alignment and progress.
* **Onboard and Train:** Oversee the execution of client programs, ensuring they are implemented effectively and deliver the expected value. Train new stores, collaborating with both store\-level contacts and senior stakeholders to ensure a smooth process.
* **Manage Portfolio Autonomously**: Take ownership of your portfolio, maintaining strong relationships and meeting business KPIs independently.
* **Enhance Team Scalability:** Contribute to the scalability of the key account team through effective documentation and process optimization.
* **Advocacy and Impact:** Act as the voice of the client within Too Good To Go, advocating for their needs and contributing to our mission of reducing food waste through successful partnerships.


As a proactive, organized and experienced “quarterback”, you will excel in the following areas:

* **Communication:** Polished and effective communication with stakeholders and team members to ensure that we deliver a high quality client engagement with our key account.
* **Value \& Solution Selling**: Experienced in solving complex business pains through solution selling, using data to influence decisions and successfully expanding partnerships through targeted upselling and cross\-selling.
* **Account Strategy**: Effectively manages pipelines and portfolios, driving partner engagement and loyalty while setting benchmarks through strategic, collaborative account leadership.
* **Technical Skills:** Experience with sales CRM, project management and analysis tools like.. Salesforce, Ninja, Looker, Asana, as is a high competency with google drive (sheets, docs, decks).
* **Problem\-Solving Skills**: Critical thinking and adaptability are essential for identifying and addressing issues as they arise during the project.
* **Project Management:** Meeting monthly meals saved milestones is critical, so time management skills and the ability to work in multiple stages of launch for different regions is imperative.
* **Organizational Skills:** Effective documentation and resource management to ensure will be critical to the successful launch and continued rollout of our key partner.
* **Cool Cucumber:** The ideal candidate is an individual who not only loves a challenge but also thrives in the face of occasional ambiguity.

**Requirements**

* Previous experience in sales, customer success, business development, or account management \- specifically selling into VP\+. Industry experience that translates well include: food, hospitality, media and technology.
* Strong accountability and demonstrated ability to effectively manage and meet key performance indicators (KPIs)
* Master communicator, you know when to speak, you know how to listen, and you know how to engage a whole room and keep their attention.
* Strong commercial acumen and appropriate assertiveness to drive deals forward.
* Proactive, solution\-focused mindset with a strong emphasis on growth and curiosity.
* Polished, detail\-oriented professional with a humble and collaborative attitude.
* Data analysis skills with raw data to create performance reports and projections to identify and understand trends, opportunities and issues.
* Enthusiasm for sustainability, food waste red

The Sales Representative is responsible for driving appropriate utilization and growth of assigned therapies within a defined geography by developing strategic customer relationships, executing account plans, navigating complex access environments, and collaborating with client counterparts. The Sales Representative serves as a trusted partner to healthcare providers, health systems, pharmacies, and other stakeholders to improve patient outcomes and ensure access to innovative therapies.

  

The Sales Representative demonstrates strong business acumen, customer focus, market expertise, and accountability while effectively collaborating across functions to deliver value for customers, patients, and the organization.

 **Why You’ll Love Working Here**

  

* We believe great people deserve great support—at work and beyond. That’s why we offer a rewards experience designed to help you thrive personally, professionally, and financially:
* Competitive pay that recognizes your experience, expertise, and impact
* Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage; accrued paid time off; 401(k) with company match; disability and life insurance; and paid maternity and paternity leave
* Company\-paid holidays so you can rest, recharge, and focus on what matters most
* Recognition programs, contests, and awards that celebrate your contributions
* Continuous growth opportunities through learning, leadership development, and career advancement support
* A collaborative culture where your ideas are valued and your work makes a difference

  

We’re also proud to be recognized for creating an exceptional employee experience:

* Best Place to Work in BioPharma — 2022, 2023, 2025
* Certified Great Place to Work® — 2021, 2023, 2025, 2026

  

Learn more: https://www.greatplacetowork.com/certified\-company/7003732

 **What will you be doing?**

  

* Drive awareness of product approval and clinical and non\-clinical decision making based on value proposition across efficacy, safety, convenience and access
* Engage and strengthen relationships with key decision\-makers and influncers across existing customer accounts.
* Strategic account planning that move customers conversations from interest to action by leveraging insights and removing barriers
* Ensure product access and provide education on product information, appropriate use, as well as on patient assistance and reimbursement resources, triaging to appropriate experts when needed
* Collaborate across multispecialty accounts, including those with CE overlap, to coordinate customer engagement and appropriately triage identified needs to the relevant Genentech cross\-functional partners, such as Case Managers, MSLs, and other internal stakeholders, ensuring customers and patients are connected to the appropriate resources and support to facilitate patient access.
* Integrate digital solutions and capabilities to provide insights and analyze trends that enable HCP adoption, patient access, and shape customer engagement experience
* Apply systems thinking to understand the interdependencies across providers, health systems, pharmacies, payers, and care teams, developing strategies that optimize patient access and treatment adoption.

  



**What do you need for this position?**

  

* 7\+ years of successful pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or related commercial experience.
* Ophthalmology or Immunology experience preferred

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.


The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

### **Who We Are**


We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real\-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end\-to\-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

**JOB OVERVIEW**


As an Operations Coordinator at Serve Robotics, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth daily operations across our commercial delivery network. Your main objective will be to execute against established strategies, manage the flow of day\-to\-day activities, and identify opportunities to streamline and strengthen operational processes. You will support the team by ensuring procedures are followed consistently, operational goals are met, and metrics are tracked with accuracy.


In this role, you will focus on operational execution first, while also proposing and implementing incremental improvements that drive efficiency, reliability, and scalability. You will collaborate closely with supervisors and leadership to align your work with the broader operational strategy, ensuring that our delivery network runs seamlessly and consistently delivers on performance targets.

**JOB DUTIES**

* Oversee and execute daily deployments by coordinating between Field Agents and Piloting teams to ensure on\-time robot operations.
* Monitor live operations and resolve issues in real time, escalating problems as needed to minimize service disruptions.
* Ensure compliance with standard operating procedures (SOPs) by reinforcing adherence to established workflows, safety protocols, and quality measures.
* Open or close depots in accordance with scheduled shift.
* Track and report key operational metrics (deployment efficiency, service uptime, utilization, etc.) to measure efficiency and highlight areas for improvement.
* Implement new processes and protocols as directed, ensuring successful rollout, team adoption, and compliance across all operational teams.
* Assist the Sr. Operations Supervisor in daily decision\-making to help prioritize resources, balance workloads, and execute test plans.
* Support onboarding and training of new Operations Associates, ensuring consistency in role expectations, SOPs, and performance standards.
* Provide ad hoc operational support across field operations, piloting, and project initiatives to maintain continuity of service and execution.

 **EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, \& SKILLS**


Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience (3\+ years in operations, logistics, or customer service)
* Strong organizational, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure with a proactive, can\-do attitude toward challenges.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Comfort with spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets)
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, as operations require.
* Comfortable driving mid\-size utility vehicles as needed.
* Valid U.S. driver’s license.
* Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays

**Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills**

* Previous experience in a high\-growth, fast\-paced startup environment
* Experience with schedule creation, resource planning, or forecasting
* Direct customer\-facing experience (field or service\-based)
* Ability to analyze data and report on operations through Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive)
* Strong passion for efficiency, innovation, and robotics

**Additional Information**

* This role is onsite and field\-based, with ad hoc movement between depots, deployment zones, and customer locations. Candidates should be comfortable with standing, walking, and lifting up to 50 lbs as part of daily operations. Occasional evening and weekend shifts may be required to support deployments and testing schedules.
* Safety compliance: Adherence to PPE rules, strict cell phone protocols, and dress codes (high\-visibility vests, safe footwear) is mandated.
* Operations Coordinators must be prepared to perform duties in various weather conditions, including inclement weather.
* This role may require the operation of company vehicles or e\-bikes for work\-related purposes. Employees must be able to perform driving duties safely and in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, with or without reasonable accommodation.

--------------------


The Account Manager oversees day\-to\-day operations and service delivery for multiple CSG client locations throughout Orange County. This is a hands\-on, field\-based leadership role requiring regular travel between assigned sites and a strong presence with clients, employees, and operational teams.

Drive for results

new_jobs.title: GCP Technical Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III), you will support Public Sector customers with cloud adoption, operational planning, technical issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination. Working alongside senior team members, you will help maintain account health and coordinate activities across customer and delivery partner teams. You will contribute to reliable, secure cloud outcomes in complex public\-sector environments. This remote role is available to candidates who can work from within the continental United States.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/21/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III) on the AI \& Engineering team, you will be responsible for:
  

* Coordinate technical activities across assigned customer workstreams and track customer issues, risks, dependencies, action items, and upcoming milestones.
* Collaborate with client Support, Product Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and customer escalations.
* Support customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, and operational readiness activities.
* Prepare materials for technical reviews, quarterly business reviews, and customer meetings; document customer needs and communicate product feedback to client teams.
* Recommend Google Cloud practices that improve adoption, reliability, security, and performance; escalate complex technical or customer issues to the Senior Technical Account Manager.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

At Deloitte, AI \& Engineering brings together engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated, sector\-focused solutions across software, data, artificial intelligence, networks, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. Our teams help clients modernize technology and data platforms, improve mission\-critical operations, and create business value through scalable engineering solutions. We tailor our delivery approach to each client's priorities, operating environment, and transformation goals.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree or 12\+ years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, software development, or technical consulting.
* 4\+ years of experience supporting customers with Google Cloud implementations, cloud transformation programs, technical support, customer launches, release management, escalations, or technical consulting.
* 1\+ years of experience designing, developing, supporting, or operating microservices, distributed systems, and application programming interfaces (APIs) using software development practices.
* Must currently hold a Google Cloud Professional certification in at least one of the following: Professional Cloud Architect; Professional Cloud Database Engineer; Professional Cloud Developer; Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer; Professional Cloud Network Engineer; Professional Cloud Security Engineer; Professional Data Engineer; Professional Machine Learning Engineer; or Professional Security Operations Engineer.
* Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  

**Preferred:**  

* Experience supporting public\-sector customers in Google Cloud environments.
* Experience coordinating customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, or operational readiness activities.
* Experience preparing materials for technical reviews or quarterly business reviews.

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,000 to $170,000\.  

  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

**Help make one\-on\-one tutoring work for Oakland children.**

Children Rising is hiring several **part\-time Program Coordinators** for the 2026–27 school year to support our literacy, math, and family engagement programs in Oakland elementary schools.

Program Coordinators are at the heart of our tutoring programs. They coordinate weekly tutoring clinics, support trained volunteer tutors working one\-on\-one with students, and help create an organized, encouraging environment where children can strengthen foundational reading and math skills.

If you enjoy working with children, are organized and encouraging, and want meaningful, hands\-on work in Oakland schools, we’d love to hear from you.

**Help make one\-on\-one tutoring work for Oakland children.**

Children Rising is hiring several **part\-time Program Coordinators** for the 2026–27 school year to support our literacy, math, and family engagement programs in Oakland elementary schools.

Program Coordinators are at the heart of our tutoring programs. They coordinate weekly tutoring clinics, support trained volunteer tutors working one\-on\-one with students, and help create an organized, encouraging environment where children can strengthen foundational reading and math skills.

If you enjoy working with children, are organized and encouraging, and want meaningful, hands\-on work in Oakland schools, we’d love to hear from you.

**What you’ll do**

* Coordinate two or more weekly tutoring clinics at Oakland school sites.

new_jobs.title: Admissions & Programs Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**POSITION OVERVIEW:**


We have an exciting full\-time opportunity for an **Admissions \& Program Operations Coordinator** at El Chante, our licensed 20\-bed residential substance use treatment program serving adult men in Oakland, Alameda County.


This role serves as the primary administrative liaison for all admissions into the residential Substance Use Disorder (SUD) program. This position is responsible for coordinating referrals, admissions, discharges, bed management, census reporting, and client appointment scheduling while ensuring compliance with agency, county, and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with the Clinical Program Manager, SUD Counselors, Resident Monitors, referral partners, county partners, medical and housing partners, and agency leadership, the Coordinator helps ensure seamless client movement through the program while maximizing residential capacity and supporting high\-quality service delivery. This collaboration ensures timely admissions, efficient bed management, effective communication, and a coordinated client experience from referral through discharge.


This is a full\-time, non\-exempt position working 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. The successful candidate will uphold and champion the agency's mission, vision, and values while contributing to a collaborative, inclusive, and client\-centered work environment.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Admissions/Intake Coordination:**
===================================

* Serves as the central point of contact for all referrals and admissions into the residential program.
* Receive and coordinate referrals from all approved referral sources.
* Schedule client intake appointments based on bed availability and program capacity.
* Confirm admission dates and times with referral partners.
* Coordinate client transportation and drop\-off times to El Chante, as appropriate.
* Communicate admission instructions to referral sources, clients, and family members when appropriate.
* Monitor the intake schedule to ensure efficient utilization of available beds.
* Collaborate with the Clinical Program Manager and clinical staff regarding admission priorities and clinical considerations.

**Resident Census and Discharge Management:**
=============================================

* Maintains accurate and up\-to\-date information regarding all client admissions and discharges.
* Tracks all scheduled admissions.
* Monitors anticipated discharge dates.
* Coordinates discharge information with internal staff and referral partners.
* Updates admission and discharge logs.
* Communicates changes in bed availability to appropriate stakeholders.
* Maintains accurate census information to support operational planning.

**Bed Management and Census Reporting:**
========================================

* Maintain accurate daily census information and complete required reporting related to residential capacity.
* Completing daily bed surveys.
* Maintaining the Daily Bed Day Sheet.
* Tracking occupied and available beds.
* Monitoring program census and bed utilization.
* Ensuring bed tracking documentation is accurate and submitted within required timeframes.
* Working with leadership to maximize occupancy while maintaining appropriate clinical placement.

**Client Scheduling and Administrative Coordination:**
======================================================

* Manage the daily administrative schedule for residential clients to ensure appointments are coordinated and communicated effectively.
* Coordinate and maintain schedules for:
* Court appearances.
* Medical appointments.
* Primary care visits.
* Dental appointments.
* Specialty medical appointments.
* Medication Assisted Treatment (MAT) clinic visits.
* Behavioral health appointments.
* Other approved external appointments.
* Communicates daily schedules with Resident Monitors, SUD Counselors, and the Clinical Program Manager to support transportation planning, clinical programming, and continuity of care.

### **Administrative Support Responsibilities**

* Provide timely, professional administrative support during scheduled hours, including monitoring and responding to phone calls, email, Slack, and stakeholder inquiries.
* Serve as a primary administrative point of contact for El Chante, providing information to clients, referral partners, community agencies, and other stakeholders and supporting positive community relationships.

San Francisco

Full time

On\-site

Marketing


  
**We are an applied AI lab building end\-to\-end software agents.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------


We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.


Our team is extremely talent\-dense. Among our founding team, we have world\-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

**The Role**


We’re looking for a hands\-on marketer to turn Cognition’s differentiated technology and customer impact into enterprise campaigns that drive pipeline and sales.


You’ll create content and experiences that influence every key stakeholder in an enterprise purchase—from engineering champions and technical evaluators to executive sponsors and economic buyers. Your work will help customers understand what’s possible, evaluate our technology, build the business case, and move confidently toward adoption.


You’ll own campaigns from idea through execution and promotion, bringing together the right message, format, audience, and channels. This role combines strong storytelling, commercial judgment, and the ability to ship quickly.


**What You’ll Do**


* **Build integrated campaigns around our most important themes.** Partner with Product Marketing to translate Cognition’s positioning, key messaging, and differentiation into campaigns that create demand and advance enterprise deals.
* **Create content across the buying journey.** Develop ebooks, research, webinars, demo experiences, practical templates and guides, workshops, business\-case tools, and other formats that help buyers move from initial interest through evaluation and purchase.
* **Reach the full buying group.** Address the distinct priorities of engineering leaders, developers, IT and security stakeholders, and business executives—with the right depth, evidence, and next step for each audience.
* **Make campaigns relevant across verticals.** Translate broad themes into industry\-specific use cases, challenges, and customer outcomes, partnering with Enterprise Demand and Sales on priority segments and accounts.
* **Own the promotion strategy.** Build distribution into every campaign from the start. Coordinate paid, email, web, social, partner, field, and sales activation with the teams responsible for each channel.
* **Bring technical differentiation to life.** Work with Product Marketing, engineers, technical experts, and customers to turn complex capabilities into credible stories and demonstrations of enterprise impact.
* **Execute from brief to launch.** Own campaign plans, content development, production, timelines, and follow\-up. Write and build directly, bringing in internal experts and external resources where needed.
* **Optimize for pipeline and revenue.** Partner with Revenue Operations and Sales to measure buying\-group engagement, qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, and sales outcomes. Use those insights to improve the next campaign.

**What Success Looks Like**


Your campaigns consistently reach the right buyers, make Cognition’s differentiation tangible, and help Sales create and win enterprise opportunities. You build a repeatable approach to turning our strongest ideas, product capabilities, and customer evidence into programs that produce measurable commercial results.


**You Should Be**


* A track record of building and executing integrated campaigns for enterprise B2B technology buyers.
* Strong content development and writing skills, with examples of work you personally took from concept to launch.
* Experience connecting content, distribution, and sales follow\-up to measurable pipeline outcomes.
* An understanding of complex enterprise buying groups and how their information needs change throughout a deal.
* The ability to move between an executive business narrative and detailed product or use\-case content.
* Strong project ownership: you can coordinate multiple contributors, make decisions, and ship high\-quality work quickly.

**Bonus Points**


* Experience marketing developer tools, AI, infrastructure, or other technical enterprise products.
* Comfort creating technical content and partnering closely with engineers or solutions teams.
* Experience building vertical campaigns, technical webinars, demo\-led programs, or content that supports active enterprise opportunities.

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager, Mid-Market
new_jobs.description:
**About Hyperbound**
--------------------


Deals are messy. Multiple stakeholders, hours of calls, and endless emails. At Hyperbound, we're building the AI Agent that will help sales teams untangle that mess.


Hyperbound is the Revenue Activation Platform: an agentic OS for sales that connects what happens to what should happen next.  

  

We came out of YC S23 and went viral with Voice Agents that reps could call to put their skills to the test. Today, we’re building AI that understands sales conversations, coaches in real time, reasons across deals, and takes action to move them forward.


We are trusted by companies like LinkedIn, Amazon, Bloomberg, Supabase, Monday.com, Notion, and Vanta. We raised a $15M Series A in October 2025, grew ARR 5× over the past year, and are growing nearly 20% month over month.

**About the role**
------------------


You'll own a book of 25 to 40 mid\-market customers ($20k to $100k\+ ARR) and be their day\-to\-day owner at Hyperbound. Your job is to get them live, get their reps using the product.

**What we need from you**
-------------------------

* **Technical depth**: You can debug, trace and reproduce a bug. You go to product or engineering when a problem is below the UI, not because you didn't want to look.
* **Relationship instinct**: You know the key people at every account, they know you, and they message you before they message anyone else. You understand what each customer is trying to fix and you build the plan around that.
* **Ownership**: When something goes wrong, you name the problem, and start solving it. You only pull in more people if required.
* **Conviction**: You push back. When a customer wants to skip the rollout plan, run the wrong cadence, or launch to the whole sales org on day one, you tell them why it won't work and sell them on the approach that will. Customers respect solutions that are sold to them, not handed over. You own the implementation and the outcome, not just the setup.

**Highly preferred**
--------------------

* Background in sales enablement, revenue enablement, or GTM ops. You've rolled out a tool or a methodology to a sales team before and know what it takes to get reps to actually use it.
* Experience implementing or administering Hyperbound or a similar sales coaching platform.

**What your regular Thursday looks like:**
------------------------------------------

* **Implementation**: Own the project plan from kickoff to first live cohort. Rollout design, integrations setup, SSO and SCIM, admin training, launch date.
* **Adoption**: Regular check\-ins, usage reviews, feature demos, and behaviour\-change plays that get reps practising and managers coaching.
* **First\-line technical support**: Discovery on the call, reproduce the issue, file a clean ticket. Solve what can be solved in the UI or a playbook yourself.
* **Voice of the customer**: Own feedback from your accounts and make sure it reaches the product.
* **Health monitoring**: Watch active users, caller counts, and implementation milestones so you act on a slipping account weeks before the renewal conversation, not during it.
* **Commercial signals**: Spot expansion and renewal risk, log it, and hand it to the account manager who owns pricing and paper.
* **Responsiveness**: Fast on Slack, tickets, and email.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* A tag\-team job. You go to customer meetings alone. Bringing a second person is the exception.
* A sales job. Retention comes first. Expansion signals get logged and handed over, not chased. A commercial role. You don't price, negotiate, or own renewal paper. You will be paired with an expansion Account manager who will take care of that.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Comfortable with the technical side: reading logs, reproducing bugs, working through configuration, and explaining a technical issue clearly to both a customer and an engineer. You don't need to be an engineer.
* You broadly understand how a sales team runs: quotas, onboarding, coaching cadences.
* You remove blockers yourself rather than routing customers to another team.
* You can run around 40 accounts and treat them differently on purpose.

**Interview Plan**
------------------

* 30 min call with James, Recruiter
* 30 min call with Keshav, Product Lead
* Take home exercise (1\-3 hours)
* Take home exercise review call (45 min)
* Final interview with Co Founders and team

**Compensation and Benefits**

* $130K\-$160k OTE
* Series A equity
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* Free lunch and dinner in the office
* Commuter benefits


We move fast, from first conversation to offer in 1\-2 weeks

* 5\+ years' experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C\-suite or senior leadership.

* Experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder calendars and travel logistics.
* Demonstrated discretion in handling confidential and sensitive information.

* Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.

**Client Services \& Communication**  

  

\- Account Management \- maintain regular, clear communication (via email, Slack, Zoom, and phone) with clients, managers, and sales teams regarding job statuses  

\- Asset Creation \- assist in compiling internal pitch decks and monthly recaps showcasing newly developed products  

\- Issue Resolution \- act as a responsive point of contact for client claims, following established procedures to correct production or delivery errors swiftly  

  

**Logistics, Data, \& Order Administration**  

  

\- Database Accuracy \- maintain accurate and real\-time records of milestones, production notes, and shipping details within our custom database  

\- Financial Administration \- generate and issue accurate client invoices upon project completion; coordinate VAT and domestic sales tax billing with the finance team  

\- Inventory \& Warehouse Coordination \- liaise with the warehouse team to coordinate incoming shipments, pickups, physical inventory counts, and product reworks  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

\- Experience \- 2 \- 4 years of relevant experience in product coordination, apparel production, account \- management, or merchandise operations  

\- Industry Knowledge \- direct experience working within an apparel, promotional products, or music merchandise environment is highly preferred  

\- Project Management \- proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment  

\- Communication \- exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both business executives and creative artists/managers  

\- Adaptability \- high comfort level working in a dynamic environment, with a "can\-do" attitude and a knack for proactive problem\-solving  

  

**Key Skill Set**  

  

\- Extreme Attention to Detail \- inherent focus on follow\-through, database accuracy, and order precision  

\- Cross\-Functional Collaboration \- ability to act as a seamless bridge between sales, art, logistics, accounting, and external partners.  

\- Logistical Aptitude \- understanding of shipping, tracking, warehousing, and production workflows  

\- Creative Alignment \- a strong eye for product quality and design, combined with a genuine passion for music culture and artist branding.  

  

Founded in 1994, A to Z Media is a family\-owned company specializing in Vinyl, CD, DVD, Promotional Product and Apparel, and Manufacturing Services. Full\-Time, Onsite to Hybrid, $45,000 \- $65,000

new_jobs.title: GCP Technical Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III), you will support Public Sector customers with cloud adoption, operational planning, technical issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination. Working alongside senior team members, you will help maintain account health and coordinate activities across customer and delivery partner teams. You will contribute to reliable, secure cloud outcomes in complex public\-sector environments. This remote role is available to candidates who can work from within the continental United States.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/21/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III) on the AI \& Engineering team, you will be responsible for:
  

* Coordinate technical activities across assigned customer workstreams and track customer issues, risks, dependencies, action items, and upcoming milestones.
* Collaborate with client Support, Product Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and customer escalations.
* Support customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, and operational readiness activities.
* Prepare materials for technical reviews, quarterly business reviews, and customer meetings; document customer needs and communicate product feedback to client teams.
* Recommend Google Cloud practices that improve adoption, reliability, security, and performance; escalate complex technical or customer issues to the Senior Technical Account Manager.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

At Deloitte, AI \& Engineering brings together engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated, sector\-focused solutions across software, data, artificial intelligence, networks, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. Our teams help clients modernize technology and data platforms, improve mission\-critical operations, and create business value through scalable engineering solutions. We tailor our delivery approach to each client's priorities, operating environment, and transformation goals.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree or 12\+ years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, software development, or technical consulting.
* 4\+ years of experience supporting customers with Google Cloud implementations, cloud transformation programs, technical support, customer launches, release management, escalations, or technical consulting.
* 1\+ years of experience designing, developing, supporting, or operating microservices, distributed systems, and application programming interfaces (APIs) using software development practices.
* Must currently hold a Google Cloud Professional certification in at least one of the following: Professional Cloud Architect; Professional Cloud Database Engineer; Professional Cloud Developer; Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer; Professional Cloud Network Engineer; Professional Cloud Security Engineer; Professional Data Engineer; Professional Machine Learning Engineer; or Professional Security Operations Engineer.
* Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  

**Preferred:**  

* Experience supporting public\-sector customers in Google Cloud environments.
* Experience coordinating customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, or operational readiness activities.
* Experience preparing materials for technical reviews or quarterly business reviews.

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,000 to $170,000\.  

  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

* Lead quarterly business reviews, executive sessions, and technical planning meetings.

* Advocate for customer requirements and influence product improvements, features, and fixes.
