Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required**  

* 8\+ or more years of customer\-facing cloud, technical consulting, support, or transformation experience, including at least four years supporting Google Cloud implementations or programs.

Purpose of Position:


Under supervision, identifies qualified participants and educates them as to the benefits of selecting MetroPlus as a managed care provider. Achieves predetermined monthly enrollments based on regularly updated goals and objectives. **Work Shifts**

* Performs related duties.


* Performs all duties of enrollment sales representative level I.

1\. Satisfactory completion of three months of training and orientation administered by MHP personnel; or,
  

2\. High School graduation or evidence of having satisfactorily passed a High School
  

Equivalency Program; and,

5\. A satisfactory equivalent combination of education, training and experience.

Dow Jones Risk Sales is a dynamic, global organization focused on helping businesses make smarter decisions through trusted news, data, insights, and information solutions. **Area of Talent:** Administrative


**Position Type:** Full Time/Non\- Exempt

**Office Location:** NYC/ Financial District

 **Position Summary:**


The Executive Assistant provides executive administrative support to the Chief of Staff in the President’s Office and the Executive Vice President, Asset Management \& REMIC. This individual will also assist and support other members of the senior leadership team and serve as a back\-up and partner to the President’s Executive Assistant. The Executive Assistant serves as the primary point of contact for internal and external constituencies on all matters pertaining to assigned executives.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Maintain executives’ appointment schedules by planning and scheduling meetings, conferences, teleconferences, and arranging travel plans, itineraries and agendas.

* Bachelor’s or associate degree preferred; or a minimum of five years of relevant experience supporting executive staff.

You will successfully manage the sales of **Richelieu’s Finishing product solutions (**Coatings, Sundries, Abraisives and Paint equipment.) through structured consultative sales discussions, ultimately serving as a business advisor towards your customers. By positioning yourself as an indispensable resource, you will enable your customers to solve problems and increase business results. In turn, you will be building a thriving business of your own.


* Work in tandem with Richelieu's Industrial Sales Representatives to schedule and hold face\-to\-face consultations with new and existing customers, learning about their business and how Richelieu Finishing product solutions can enhance their results
* Maintain accountability for the growth of your provided territory, both through the development of existing relationships as well as the acquisition of new customers
* Identify and analyze past buying patterns of current accounts, and brainstorm ways to become their stronger, more inclusive supplier

* Educate yourself on, and continuously stay up to date with, Richelieu’s Finishing product offerings, as well as ever\-changing market conditions and competitive analysis
* Hold responsibility for system information and reporting in CRM application
* As this position requires regular automobile travel, you must have your own independent, reliable transportation. This position requires you to work "in the field," making in\-person visits to customers three to four days per week
* This position may involve lifting/pushing/carrying items up to 50 pounds, working around fumes, airborne particles, or toxic chemicals

  


**What We Are Looking For**


* Technically\-minded, preferably with a **background or experience in chemistry or science, and/or spray coatings**
* University degree – preferred in chemistry /science
* Spray application finish background is a plus
* Must have an understanding of (or ability to quickly gain expertise in) coatings and finishing with various products, applications, and methods
* Passionate, proactive, coachable, strong work ethic
* Ability to schedule and manage your own time, delivering on the activities that produce results
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
* Developed analytical, planning, organizing, and monitoring skills
* Experience in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software an asset
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; must be able to effectively use Excel, Word, Outlook for daily responsibilities and tasks


**Compensation and Benefits**


* Competitive market\-based salary plus monthly commissions
* Monthly car allowance and covered fuel
* Business expense reimbursement
* Group insurance program (medical, dental, vision, life, disability, etc.)

new_jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant serves as a strategic partner to three senior leaders, providing high\-level support that enables focus on priorities, decision\-making, and business outcomes. This role goes beyond calendar management and administrative support. The successful candidate functions as an orchestrator, connector, and operational quarterback who creates structure, drives follow\-through, and anticipates needs before they arise.  

  

The Executive Assistant will support an SVP, Sales Inventory, NextGear Capital and EVBS, a VP of Marketing and Communication Inventory, NextGear Capital, EVBS and International, and a VP of Sales, Commercial and National Dealer. These functions require different skill sets, stakeholder relationships, communication styles, client interactions, and operating rhythms. The ideal candidate must be highly adaptable and capable of seamlessly shifting between sales\-driven client engagement and marketing and communications priorities while maintaining professionalism, discretion, organization, and strong follow\-through.  

  

This is not a traditional executive assistant role focused solely on scheduling and administrative support. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted business partner who helps create alignment, manages competing priorities, and supports leaders who engage with diverse internal and external stakeholders.  

  

**This role is expected to maintain a regular in\-office presence of at least four days per week. The role is Atlanta based.**  

  

Because this position supports senior leaders with significant client\-facing responsibilities, flexibility is required to be onsite when clients, leadership meetings, executive visits, or key business events occur, even when those days fall outside the employee's normal in\-office schedule.  

  

Success in this role requires strong judgment regarding visibility, responsiveness, preparedness, and executive support.

new_jobs.title: Sanitation & Food Safety Program Specialist, US
new_jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced and highly technical Sanitation \& Food Safety Program Specialist, US to join our growing team!
  
This corporate\-level role is responsible for advancing and standardizing sanitation programs across DO \& CO’s U.S. operations. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on food safety professional who can assess complex production environments, identify sanitation and microbiological risks, lead root\-cause investigations, and translate technical requirements into practical, sustainable solutions.
  
  

About DO \& CO
  
  

We have a passion for hospitality culinary delights on every elevated floor and in the sky. With our three business segments, Airline Catering, International Event Catering, Restaurants, Lounges \& Hotels, we offer gourmet entertainment all over the world. We operate in 33 locations, 12 countries and 3 Continents, maintaining the highest standard of quality in both our products and services. We refine the classics, develop the unknown and grow constantly – sometimes beyond our own expectations.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Provide technical oversight and guidance for sanitation programs across DO \& CO’s U.S. facilities.
* Develop, standardize, and continuously improve SSOPs, Master Sanitation Schedules, cleaning procedures, and verification standards.
* Conduct sanitation assessments across production areas, ready\-to\-eat environments, equipment, coolers, freezers, dishrooms, drains, docks, and waste areas.
* Evaluate cleaning methods, chemicals, concentrations, contact times, equipment, sanitation contractors, and service providers.
* Identify hygienic\-design concerns and sanitation vulnerabilities and partner with facility teams to implement sustainable solutions.
* Establish standardized pre\-operational inspection and release programs across facilities.
* Conduct independent inspections to verify sanitation effectiveness and production readiness.
* Identify food residue, grease, biofilm risks, standing water, damaged surfaces, inaccessible areas, and other sanitation deficiencies
* Ensure corrective actions are completed and effective before equipment or production areas are released for use.
* Maintain consistent documentation, escalation, and follow\-up procedures for significant findings.
* Support the development and continuous improvement of Environmental Monitoring Programs, with particular focus on ready\-to\-eat and high\-risk areas.
* Review sampling plans, locations, frequencies, zoning, ATP results, and environmental trend data.
* Lead or support investigations involving recurring environmental findings or pathogens, including Listeria species and Listeria monocytogenes.
* Verify intensified cleaning, resampling, mitigation activities, allergen\-cleaning validation, and corrective actions.
* Ensure sanitation tools are properly segregated, dedicated, and color\-coded where required.
* Verify the proper selection, concentration, labeling, storage, dispensing, and use of sanitation chemicals.
* Ensure cleaning practices follow manufacturer instructions and established sanitation procedures.
* Evaluate equipment and facilities for harborage points, damaged surfaces, standing water, condensation, deteriorated seals, and other contamination risks.
* Participate in sanitation reviews for new equipment, renovations, construction projects, and process changes.
* Partner with Maintenance, Engineering, Operations, FSQA, chemical suppliers, and facility leadership to resolve sanitation\-related deficiencies.
* Review pest\-control programs, activity trends, and corrective actions with FSQA and facility leadership.
* Assess waste\-handling areas, docks, compactors, recycling areas, and exterior conditions for sanitation and pest risks.
* Verify sanitation procedures supporting Halal segregation and shared\-equipment controls.
* Evaluate cleaning and tool\-control practices designed to prevent allergen and Halal/non\-Halal cross\-contact.
* Lead sanitation\-related investigations and root\-cause analyses.
* Develop risk\-based corrective and preventive action recommendations.
* Verify the completion and sustained effectiveness of sanitation CAPAs.
* Identify recurring findings across facilities and recommend long\-term, systemic solutions.
* Escalate significant sanitation and food safety risks to FSQA leadership.
* Develop and deliver technical training on SSOPs, GMPs, chemical safety, sanitation verification, environmental pathogen controls, and cross\-contamination prevention.
* Coach Sanitation Managers, supervisors, FSQA personnel, Operations teams, and frontline employees.
* Verify training effectiveness through field observations and follow\-up assessments.
* Support FDA inspections, customer audits, third\-party audits, and internal food safety assessments.
* Assist facilities with regulatory observations, customer findings, CAPAs, and effectiveness verification.
* Promote sanitation as a critical food safety preventive control and shared organizational responsibility.


Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Food Safety, Biology, Environmental Health, Public Health, Food Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* At least five years of progressive experience in food manufacturing, airline catering, commissary operations, sanitation, food safety, or quality assurance.
* Strong working knowledge of food sanitation, GMPs, HACCP, Environmental Monitoring Programs, sanitation verification, and preventive controls.
* Demonstrated experience conducting sanitation inspections, investigations, root\-cause analyses, and corrective\-action follow\-up.
* Experience identifying microbiological, sanitation, hygienic\-design, allergen, and cross\-contamination risks in complex food\-production environments.
* Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

Overview:
**About Vantage Group**

  

Vantage Group is a global leader in airport and transportation investment, development, management, and advisor services. Since 1994, Vantage's corporate and network\-wide team has managed an award\-winning portfolio, building strong partnerships that integrate global expertise and local know\-how to solve complex transportation challenges at every network location. Over three decades, Vantage has built a track record of creating customized solutions to transform airports and transportation centers that benefit the passengers, stakeholders, and communities they serve. Vantage is a wholly owned strategic platform of Investcorp Corsair Infrastructure Partners for capital deployment in the airport and transportation sectors. Visit vantagegroup.com to learn more.  

  

**Position Summary**

  

The Marketing Coordinator supports the planning and execution of marketing programs for the concessions program at Chicago Midway International Airport (MDW). This role helps coordinate guest\-facing marketing messaging, digital campaigns, signage, promotional materials, and customer activations that drive passenger engagement, support operator visibility, and contribute to commercial goals. The Marketing Coordinator works closely with the Director, Commercial Marketing, the on\-site MDW team, operators, client stakeholders, graphic designers, and vendors to keep projects moving from concept through execution. The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail\-oriented marketer with strong project management instincts, sound creative judgment, and a willingness to support both strategic planning and hands\-on execution.


Responsibilities:
**Key Responsibilities**

  

Program Messaging and Campaign Coordination

* Coordinate the development, production, approval, and placement of digital and printed materials, including Meta and WiFi campaign assets, in\-terminal signage, digital screen content, promotional materials, and other customer\-facing communications.
* Work with graphic designers, operators, internal stakeholders, and vendors to develop campaign creative, messaging, signage, and visual assets that are clear, brand\-aligned, and designed to capture passenger attention.
* Recommend new messaging tests, creative approaches, channel opportunities, and technology\-enabled tactics based on business needs, prior campaign insights, and evolving marketing goals.
* Manage timelines, approvals, creative routing, production needs, vendor coordination, and launch requirements to ensure materials are completed accurately, on time, and in alignment with stakeholder expectations.
* Act as a MDW Commercial brand ambassador to ensure brand is implemented in both design and messaging of branded environments.
* Partner with the Commercial Analyst to review available campaign, event, sales, and operational data, identify relevant takeaways, and summarize insights for internal and client stakeholders.


Customer Activations

* Manage the design, planning, and execution of customer\-facing activations and promotional events at the airport in partnership with the on\-site MDW team, operators, vendors, and client stakeholders.
* Develop event plans, timelines, run\-of\-show documents, briefing materials, and supplies to support clear coordination and successful execution.
* Coordinate event logistics including materials, signage, supplies, staffing support, vendor needs, operator participation, set\-up, on\-site execution, and breakdown.
* Evaluate event performance and gather feedback to identify learnings, improve future activations, and share results with relevant stakeholders.


Relationship Management

Other

* Support marketing needs for other Vantage airport locations or commercial programs as needed.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

  

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
* A minimum of two years’ of progressive experience.
* Ability to obtain and maintain all required airport security clearances and access privileges.
* Analytical skills to evaluate data and performance/operational metrics.
* Highly proficient in MS Office suite or related software \[Word, Excel, Teams, PowerPoint, Outlook, Project], e\-mail platforms, WordPress, social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn), and Canva.

 **Skills \& Capabilities**

  

* Comfortable wearing multiple hats, with the ability to shift from analyzing performance data to executing events, coordinating logistics, or developing creative materials depending on the needs of the day.
* Willingness to take a hands\-on approach to all aspects of marketing execution, from strategy and creative development to the practical, behind\-the\-scen

Production, Event, and Client Management

* Maintain accurate records, documentation, databases, calendars, and project tracking systems throughout the project lifecycle.
* Serve as an onsite point of contact for clients, vendors, talent, and event organizers, escalating issues and questions to the appropriate team members as needed.

Framed Eyewear is an independent optical business focused on providing a highly personalized, luxury patient experience. We are a small, growing company that values craftsmanship, professionalism, education, and genuine relationships over the traditional high\-volume retail environment.

We're looking for a Patient Experience \& Outreach Coordinator to become an important part of our growing Chicago team.

This is a people\-focused position for someone who enjoys making people feel welcome, building relationships, creating opportunities, and representing a business they genuinely believe in.

The role combines patient experience, appointment generation, community outreach, light styling, and day\-to\-day showroom support.

We're open to candidates from a variety of backgrounds, including opticians, optical technicians, retail professionals, hospitality professionals, and people with strong customer\-service and relationship\-building experience.

Patient Experience

Patient experience comes first whenever a patient or visitor is in the showroom.

* Welcome every patient and visitor in a warm, professional, and genuine manner
* Serve as the first point of contact for walk\-ins, phone calls, messages, and inquiries

Community Outreach \& Business Development

Showroom \& Administrative Support

* Restock basic supplies and showroom materials as needed
* Receive, organize, and put away deliveries when needed

Who We’re Looking For

Optical experience is welcome but not required. Opticians and optical technicians, particularly those earlier in their careers, are encouraged to apply.

* Naturally personable and comfortable talking with people they don't know
* Understands and embraces the expectations of a luxury, high\-touch environment

A Career, Not Just a Job

At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious mission: to **inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.**


More than 1/3 of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet. 10% of greenhouse gas emissions come from food waste and loss.


Through our marketplace app, we connect businesses that have unsold, surplus food, with consumers who can buy and enjoy it at a discount of the retail value. We are a certified B Corporation with a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste. Alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.


We’re looking for an exceptional **Enterprise Customer Success Manager** to join the team at Too Good To Go to lead the US partnerships.


**Your role**


As a **Enterprise Customer Success Manager**, you will play a pivotal role in driving the success of our most strategic partnerships. You will be responsible for managing a portfolio of key account partners, building and sustaining strong relationships with senior stakeholders. With a proactive, consultative, and data\-driven approach, you will identify opportunities to increase meals saved, grow account value, and expand product adoption. By deeply understanding each partner’s business challenges, you will deliver tailored solutions aligned with our value drivers, ensuring long\-term mutual success.


In this role, you will oversee the full account lifecycle from onboarding through to ongoing optimization. You will lead the development and execution of strategic account plans, conduct regular performance reviews such as Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and focus on driving retention at both HQ and store levels. Your ability to effectively pitch our full product portfolio will be key to introducing new categories and enhancing partner engagement. Collaborating closely with Sales, Store Operations, and Marketing teams, you will ensure strong store coverage, optimize supply quality, and deliver a seamless partner experience, all in support of our mission to reduce food waste.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Drive Account Growth**: Own the health and success of your customers from launch through expansion, with a focus on optimizing meals saved.
* **Analyze and Manage Risks**: Analyze store data to forecast meal savings accurately. Identify, communicate, and manage store risks proactively throughout the year, and lead in developing resolution strategies.
* **Provide Consultative Support:** Offer expert recommendations on food\-saving practices
* **Lead Client Meetings:** Regularly lead and present at client meetings, both in\-person and via video conference, to ensure alignment and progress.
* **Onboard and Train:** Oversee the execution of client programs, ensuring they are implemented effectively and deliver the expected value. Train new stores, collaborating with both store\-level contacts and senior stakeholders to ensure a smooth process.
* **Manage Portfolio Autonomously**: Take ownership of your portfolio, maintaining strong relationships and meeting business KPIs independently.
* **Enhance Team Scalability:** Contribute to the scalability of the key account team through effective documentation and process optimization.
* **Advocacy and Impact:** Act as the voice of the client within Too Good To Go, advocating for their needs and contributing to our mission of reducing food waste through successful partnerships.


As a proactive, organized and experienced “quarterback”, you will excel in the following areas:

* **Communication:** Polished and effective communication with stakeholders and team members to ensure that we deliver a high quality client engagement with our key account.
* **Value \& Solution Selling**: Experienced in solving complex business pains through solution selling, using data to influence decisions and successfully expanding partnerships through targeted upselling and cross\-selling.
* **Account Strategy**: Effectively manages pipelines and portfolios, driving partner engagement and loyalty while setting benchmarks through strategic, collaborative account leadership.
* **Technical Skills:** Experience with sales CRM, project management and analysis tools like.. Salesforce, Ninja, Looker, Asana, as is a high competency with google drive (sheets, docs, decks).
* **Problem\-Solving Skills**: Critical thinking and adaptability are essential for identifying and addressing issues as they arise during the project.
* **Project Management:** Meeting monthly meals saved milestones is critical, so time management skills and the ability to work in multiple stages of launch for different regions is imperative.
* **Organizational Skills:** Effective documentation and resource management to ensure will be critical to the successful launch and continued rollout of our key partner.
* **Cool Cucumber:** The ideal candidate is an individual who not only loves a challenge but also thrives in the face of occasional ambiguity.

**Requirements**

* Previous experience in sales, customer success, business development, or account management \- specifically selling into VP\+. Industry experience that translates well include: food, hospitality, media and technology.
* Strong accountability and demonstrated ability to effectively manage and meet key performance indicators (KPIs)
* Master communicator, you know when to speak, you know how to listen, and you know how to engage a whole room and keep their attention.
* Strong commercial acumen and appropriate assertiveness to drive deals forward.
* Proactive, solution\-focused mindset with a strong emphasis on growth and curiosity.
* Polished, detail\-oriented professional with a humble and collaborative attitude.
* Data analysis skills with raw data to create performance reports and projections to identify and understand trends, opportunities and issues.
* Enthusiasm for sustainability, food waste red
